== Anmerkungen ==

== Einzelnachweise ==
We Want Our Mummy (br.: Entre M\u00famias e Patetas) \u00e9 um filme de curta-metragem estadunidense de 1939, dirigido por Del Lord. \u00c9 o 37\u00ba de um total de 190 filmes da s\u00e9rie com os Tr\u00eas Patetas produzida pela Columbia Pictures entre 1934 e 1959.

== Enredo ==
Dr. Powell (Bud Jamison) e o professor Wilson (James C. Morton) contrataram os Tr\u00eas Patetas como detetives particulares para localizar o professor Tuttle, que desapareceu enquanto tentava encontrar a m\u00famia do rei eg\u00edpcio, Rootin Tootin, no Cairo. 
Os Patetas verificam o por\u00e3o e ajudam um homem a levar uma caixa para um caminh\u00e3o, sem saber que Tuttle est\u00e1 amarrado e amorda\u00e7ado por dentro. Eles ent\u00e3o, s\u00e3o informados pelos donos do museu para encontrarem o t\u00famulo e trazerem de volta a m\u00famia, para que eles possam receber US $ 5.000. Os Tr\u00eas Patetas chamam um t\u00e1xi na cidade de Nova York e informam \u00e0 um motorista perplexo (Eddie Laughton) que eles est\u00e3o partindo para o Egito.
Uma vez no Egito, os rapazes, iludidos por uma miragem, acreditam que um peda\u00e7o vazio de areia \u00e9 um lago de \u00e1gua fria e mergulham, caindo logo depois, em alguns t\u00faneis subterr\u00e2neos que podem lev\u00e1-los ao t\u00famulo de Rootin 'Tootin'. O trio come\u00e7a a investigar, mas acabam separados, com Curly fugindo, ap\u00f3s se encontrar com uma m\u00famia viva. Ele sai correndo se encontra novamente com seus amigos.
Ap\u00f3s sua chegada, os Patetas descobrem que Tuttle est\u00e1 sendo ref\u00e9m por um grupo de ladr\u00f5es. Eles o t\u00eam amarrado e amorda\u00e7ado enquanto os Tr\u00eas Patetas, ficam vagando atrav\u00e9s dos t\u00faneis subterr\u00e2neos. Curly encontra o que acreditava ser a m\u00famia de Rootin 'Tootin' em uma sala secreta, ativada por uma porta de armadilha. Quando Curly tenta peg\u00e1-la, ele desajeitadamente a deixa cair, desintegrando-a em p\u00f3.
Eles ent\u00e3o ouvem o chefe da gangue, Jackson (Dick Curtis), amea\u00e7ando o professor, na esperan\u00e7a de fazer com que ele diga aos bandidos onde est\u00e1 a m\u00famia. O professor, assustado, lhes revela o local e \u00e9 advertido pelos vil\u00f5es, que se a m\u00famia n\u00e3o estiver l\u00e1, ele e os Tr\u00eas Patetas ser\u00e3o mortos. Os Patetas percebem o perigo que correm se Jackson descobrir a m\u00famia desintegrada. Ent\u00e3o, Moe tem a ideia de fazer Curly se disfar\u00e7ar de m\u00famia. Curly responde dizendo: "Eu n\u00e3o posso ser uma m\u00famia, eu sou um papai!" - mas ele cede, quando alertado que n\u00e3o tem alternativa. 
Curly se deita na laje de pedra j\u00e1 disfar\u00e7ado, quando os bandidos chegam. Jackson decide procurar as j\u00f3ias cortando o corpo de Curly, fazendo com que ele abra as bandagens em seu peito. Jackson ent\u00e3o, encontra o casaco de Curly, puxa um jornal e l\u00ea "'Yanks ganham a World Series' - voc\u00ea pode bater isso!" Curly pega o jornal respondendo: "Sim, e eu ganhei cinco d\u00f3lares!" 
Percebendo que foi enganado, Jackson tenta pegar Curly, mas no processo de perseguir os Patetas, ele e seus companheiros caem em um po\u00e7o. Os Tr\u00eas Patetas ent\u00e3o, contam ao Professor Tuttle que Curly havia destru\u00eddo a m\u00famia. No entanto, a m\u00famia que foi destru\u00edda n\u00e3o era a do Rei Rootin 'Tootin', mas de sua esposa, a rainha Hotsy-Totsy. Ele mostra uma pequena tumba, contendo a verdadeira m\u00famia de Rootin Tootin, que era um an\u00e3o.
Um jacar\u00e9 rasteja pelo quarto quando ningu\u00e9m est\u00e1 olhando e fica parado. Curly olha para o jacar\u00e9 e acredita que \u00e9 outra m\u00famia, planejando lev\u00e1-lo para casa com ele. Quando Curly se inclina para pegar uma corda, o jacar\u00e9 o morde. Quando Curly diz a Moe, Larry e ao professor o que aconteceu, eles n\u00e3o acreditam nele - at\u00e9 que o jacar\u00e9 surge novamente. Os quatro saem correram com medo dos t\u00faneis subterr\u00e2neos.

== Notas da produ\u00e7\u00e3o ==
We Want Our Mummy foi o primeiro filme dos Tr\u00eas Patetas que usou "Three Blind Mice" como m\u00fasica oficial dos curtas (a can\u00e7\u00e3o tamb\u00e9m apareceu prematuramente em Flat Stooges de 1938, devido a alguma confus\u00e3o na data de lan\u00e7amento do filme). Esta vers\u00e3o de "Three Blind Mice", muitas vezes conhecida como a vers\u00e3o "sliding strings", seria usada regularmente at\u00e9 1942, em What's the Matador?. Uma vers\u00e3o alternativa da vers\u00e3o "sliding strings" seria usada por um breve per\u00edodo come\u00e7ando em 1945 com If a Body Meets a Body.
A refer\u00eancia \u00e0 S\u00e9rie Mundial de beisebol de 1938 com o jogo entre New Yankees e Chicago Cubs \u00e9 um reconhecimento raro de um evento esportivo da vida real.

== Tham kh\u1ea3o ==
Garibaldi An\u0131t\u0131 (Rus\u00e7a: \u041f\u0430\u043c\u044f\u0442\u043d\u0438\u043a \u0413\u0430\u0440\u0438\u0431\u0430\u043b\u044c\u0434\u0438 (\u0422\u0430\u0433\u0430\u043d\u0440\u043e\u0433)), Taganrog'da bulunan, \u0130talya'n\u0131n en b\u00fcy\u00fck kahraman\u0131 ve yurtseverlerinden biri Giuseppe Garibaldi'nin an\u0131s\u0131na in\u015fa edilen an\u0131t. Sovyetler Birli\u011fi'nde Giuseppe Garibaldi'nin onuruna verilen tek an\u0131tt\u0131r.

== Tarihi ==
An\u0131t David Begalov taraf\u0131ndan 2 Haziran 1961 y\u0131l\u0131nda in\u015fa edildi. 1961'de Taganrog, Garibaldi'yi kendisine ait \u015fehir sokaklar\u0131n\u0131n birinden (Ulitsa Garibaldi) bekletti ve Garibaldi'ye \u015ferefine bir dikilita\u015f ile, geyi\u011fini Clorinda'n\u0131n bulundu\u011fu limandan uzak tuttu. Dikilita\u015f, u\u00e7an pankart\u0131 temsil eden 5 metre y\u00fcksekli\u011findeki bir stella idi. Arka planda \u015fu \u015fekilde a\u00e7\u0131klama vard\u0131r: 1833'te Giuseppe Garibaldi ya\u015fam\u0131n\u0131 \u00d6zg\u00fcrl\u00fck ve Anavatan\u0131 - \u0130talya'n\u0131n birle\u015fmesi i\u00e7in ithaf ederek yemin etti. Ulusal kahraman Giuseppe Garibaldi liderli\u011finde \u00fclke \u00f6zg\u00fcrle\u015ftirildi ve birle\u015fti. \u00d6n tarafta diyor ki: Garibaldi'nin \u015fahs\u0131nda \u0130talya'n\u0131n mucizeler \u00fcretebilen ve mucizeler \u00fcreten antik bir kahraman\u0131 vard\u0131 (Friedrich Engels).
Garibaldi'nin Taganrog'u ziyaretine \u015ferefli dikilita\u015f, \u0130talya'n\u0131n kurtulu\u015funun y\u00fcz\u00fcnc\u00fc y\u0131l\u0131 i\u00e7in 2 Haziran 1961'de a\u00e7\u0131ld\u0131. Yakovenko an\u0131t projesini ger\u00e7ekle\u015ftirdi. Bas kabartmas\u0131 (\u0130talyan kahraman\u0131n profili ve palmiye dal\u0131) sanat\u00e7\u0131 Baranov taraf\u0131ndan \u00fcretildi. 1986'da, teknik yard\u0131mlarla bas kabartmas\u0131 de\u011fi\u015ftirildi ve sanat\u00e7\u0131 Beglov'un yeni bir kabartmas\u0131 kuruldu.
Taganrog'un Giuseppe Garibaldi an\u0131t\u0131n\u0131n foto\u011fraf\u0131, 21 Temmuz 2007'de New York'taki Garibaldi-Meucci M\u00fczesinde a\u00e7\u0131lan "\u0130ki D\u00fcnyal\u0131 Kahraman: D\u00fcnyaya Ait Garibaldi An\u0131tlar\u0131" sergisinde sergilendi.
12 Eyl\u00fcl 2007'de, yenilenmi\u015f Giuseppe Garibaldi an\u0131t\u0131, "\u015eehir G\u00fcn\u00fc" kutlamalar\u0131 s\u0131ras\u0131nda ve Taganrog'daki iki\u015ferli Giuseppe Garibaldi'ye adanan etkinliklerin program\u0131 kapsam\u0131nda a\u00e7\u0131ld\u0131. \u0130talyan devrimci torunu ve Moskova'daki \u0130talyan el\u00e7ili\u011finin temsilcileri olan Annita Garibaldi-Jallet olaya kat\u0131ld\u0131. Friedrich Engels'in teklifi \u00f6n taraftan kald\u0131r\u0131lm\u0131\u015f, arka taraftaki a\u00e7\u0131klama de\u011fi\u015fmeden kald\u0131.

== Galeri ==

== Kaynak\u00e7a ==
Marea Caspic\u0103 este cel mai mare lac din lume, a\u0219ezat la hotarul Europei \u0219i Asiei, \u0219i este numit mare datorit\u0103 dimensiunilor sale foarte mari. Marea Caspic\u0103 reprezint\u0103 un lac lipsit de scurgere, iar apa din el este salin\u0103, de la 0,05 % la gura de v\u0103rsare a r\u00e2ului Volga p\u00e2n\u0103 la 11-13 % \u00een partea sud-estic\u0103. Nivelul apei variaz\u0103 de la un an la altul, \u00een prezent fiind aprox. 28 m sub nivelul oceanului planetar. Suprafa\u021ba M\u0103rii Caspice (f\u0103r\u0103 Kara Bogaz Gol) m\u0103soar\u0103 371.000 km\u00b2, iar ad\u00e2ncimea ei maxim\u0103 este de 1025 m.

== Etimologie ==
Conform unei ipoteze, Marea Caspic\u0103 a fost numit\u0103 a\u0219a \u00een cinstea unor triburi vechi de cresc\u0103tori de cai \u2013 Caspiev \u2013 care au locuit \u00een secolul I \u00ee.Hr. pe coasta de nord-vest a lacului. Pe parcursul istoriei, Marea Caspic\u0103 a avut cca. 70 de nume: Marea Hyrcan\u0103, Marea Hval\u00e2n\u0103, Marea Hazar\u0103, Marea Abescun\u0103, Marea Saray, Marea Derbent, Sihai \u0219i alte denumiri provenite de la na\u021bionalit\u0103\u021bi \u0219i triburi diferite.

== Pozi\u021bia fizico-geografic\u0103 ==
Marea Caspic\u0103 este amplasat\u0103 la hotarul dintre cele dou\u0103 p\u0103r\u021bi ale Eurasiei: Europa \u0219i Asia. Dup\u0103 form\u0103 aminte\u0219te de litera latin\u0103 \u201eS\u201d. Marea Caspic\u0103 se \u00eentinde de la nord la sud pe aprox. 1200 km (36\u00b034' - 47\u00b013' lat.N); de la vest la est \u2013 de la 195 la 435 km, \u00een medie, 310 \u2013 320 km (46\u00b0 - 56\u00b0 long.E).
Marea Caspic\u0103 se \u00eemparte, dup\u0103 propriet\u0103\u021bile fizico-geografice, \u00een 3 segmente: Caspica de Nord, de Mijloc \u0219i de Sud. Linia care desparte Caspica de Nord de cea de Mijloc trece pe linia insula Cecenia - promontoriul Tub-Karagan, iar cea care desparte Caspica de Mijloc de cea de Sud \u2013 pe linia insula J\u00eeloi - promontoriul Gan-Gulu. Suprafa\u021ba Caspicei de Nord, de Mijloc \u0219i de Sud alc\u0103tuie\u0219te, respectiv, 25, 36 \u0219i 39 % din suprafa\u021ba total\u0103 a m\u0103rii.

=== \u021a\u0103rmul ===
Lungimea liniei de \u021b\u0103rm a M\u0103rii Caspice se estimeaz\u0103 ca fiind de 6500 \u2013 6700 km; p\u00e2n\u0103 la 7000 km dac\u0103 sunt luate \u00een considerare \u0219i insulele. Pe cea mai mare parte a teritoriului, malurile M\u0103rii Caspice sunt joase \u0219i netede. \u00cen partea de nord, acestea sunt t\u0103iate de deltele fluviilor Volga \u0219i Ural, sunt joase \u0219i ml\u0103\u0219tinoase, iar apa este acoperit\u0103 \u00een multe locuri cu tufi\u0219uri \u0219i verdea\u021b\u0103. \u021a\u0103rmul estic este dominat de maluri calcaroase, dup\u0103 care se \u00eentind de\u0219erturi \u0219i semide\u0219erturi. Malurile cele mai calcaroase sunt observate pe \u021b\u0103rmul de vest \u00een regiunea peninsulei Ab\u0219eron (\u00een rus\u0103 \u0410\u043f\u0448\u0435\u0440\u043e\u043d\u0441\u043a\u0438\u0439) \u0219i pe \u021b\u0103rmul de est \u00een regiunea golfului Kazah (\u00een rus\u0103 \u041a\u0430\u0437\u0430\u0445\u0441\u043a\u0438\u0439) \u0219i a \u201eKara-Bogaz-Gol\u201d-ului.

=== Peninsule ===
Cele mai mari peninsule ale M\u0103rii Caspice:

Agrahan
Ab\u0219eron, situat\u0103 pe \u021b\u0103rmul vestic pe teritoriul statului Azerbaidjan, la hotarul de nord-est al Marelui Caucaz ; pe teritoriul ei se afl\u0103 ora\u0219ele Baku \u0219i Sumgait
Buzaci
Mang\u00e2\u0219lac, situat\u0103 pe \u021b\u0103rmul estic pe teritoriul statului Kazahstan; pe teritoriul ei se afl\u0103 ora\u0219ul Aktau
Tub-Karagan

=== Insule ===
\u00cen Marea Caspic\u0103 se g\u0103sesc cca. 50 insule de dimensiuni relativ mari, a c\u0103ror suprafa\u021b\u0103 total\u0103 este aprox. 350 km\u00b2.
Cele mai mari insule:

A\u0219ur-Ada
Garasu
Gum
Da\u0219
Zira
Zeanbil
Qur Da\u0219\u00ee
Hara-Zira
Senghi-Mugania
Cecenia
Ci\u00eeg\u00eel

=== Golfuri ===
Cele mai mari golfuri ale M\u0103rii Caspice:

Argahanski (\u00een rus\u0103 \u0410\u0433\u0440\u0430\u0445\u0430\u043d\u0441\u043a\u0438\u0439)
Komsomole\u021b (\u00een rus\u0103 \u041a\u043e\u043c\u0441\u043e\u043c\u043e\u043b\u0435\u0446)
Mang\u00e2\u0219lac (\u00een rus\u0103 \u041c\u0430\u043d\u0433\u044b\u0448\u043b\u0430\u043a)
Kazah (\u00een rus\u0103 \u041a\u0430\u0437\u0430\u0445\u0441\u043a\u0438\u0439)
Turkmenba\u0219\u00ee (\u00een rus\u0103 \u0422\u0443\u0440\u043a\u043c\u0435\u043d\u0431\u0430\u0448\u0438)
Turkmen (\u00een rus\u0103 \u0422\u0443\u0440\u043a\u043c\u0435\u043d)
G\u00e2z\u00e2lagaci (\u00een rus\u0103 \u0413\u044b\u0437\u044b\u043b\u0430\u0433\u0430\u0447)
Astrahani (\u00een rus\u0103 \u0410\u0441\u0442\u0440\u0430\u0445\u0430\u043d\u044c)
G\u00e2zlar (\u00een rus\u0103 \u0413\u044b\u0437\u043b\u0430\u0440)
Girkan (\u00een rus\u0103 \u0413\u0438\u0440\u043a\u0430\u043d)
Enzeli (\u00een rus\u0103 \u042d\u043d\u0437\u0435\u043b\u0438)

=== Kara Bogaz Gol ===

Pe \u021b\u0103rmul estic se afl\u0103 un lac salin \u2013 Kara-Bogaz-Gol \u2013 care p\u00e2n\u0103 \u00een 1980 era o lagun\u0103 a M\u0103rii Caspice, unit\u0103 de ea printr-o str\u00e2mtoare \u00eengust\u0103. \u00cen anul 1980 a fost construit un dig care desp\u0103r\u021bea Kara-Bogaz-Gol de Marea Caspic\u0103, iar \u00een 1984 a ap\u0103rut o construc\u021bie de evacuare a apei, \u00een urma c\u0103reia nivelul apei \u00een Kara-Bogaz-Gol a sc\u0103zut cu c\u00e2\u021biva metri. \u00cen 1992 str\u00e2mtoarea a fost restaurat\u0103, dar prin ea din Marea Caspic\u0103 curge o cantitate mare de ap\u0103, care \u00een Kara-Bogaz-Gol se evapor\u0103. Zilnic, din Marea Caspic\u0103 se vars\u0103 \u00een Kara-Bogaz-Gol 8 \u2013 10 km\u00b3 de ap\u0103 (dup\u0103 alte date - 25 de mii km\u00b3) \u0219i circa 150 de mii de tone de sare.

=== R\u00e2urile ===

\u00cen Marea Caspic\u0103 se vars\u0103 130 de r\u00e2uri, dintre care doar trei formeaz\u0103 la gura de v\u0103rsare delte.
Cele mai mari r\u00e2uri care se vars\u0103 \u00een Marea Caspic\u0103 sunt:

Volga (\u0412\u043e\u043b\u0433\u0430)
Terek (\u0422\u0435\u0440\u0435\u043a), Rusia
Ural
Emba, Kazahstan
Kura, Azerbaidjan
Samur, la grani\u021ba dintre Rusia \u0219i Azerbaidjan
Atrek, Turkmenistan
Cel mai mare r\u00e2u care se vars\u0103 \u00een Marea Caspic\u0103 este Volga, debitul anual de ap\u0103 fiind de 215 \u2013 224 km\u00b3. Volga, Ural, Terek \u0219i Emba dau M\u0103rii Caspice 88 - 90 procente din totalul volumului de ap\u0103 pe care marea o cap\u0103t\u0103 de la r\u00e2uri.

=== Bazinul ===

Suprafa\u021ba bazinului M\u0103rii Caspice este de cca. 3,1 - 3,2 milioane km\u00b2, ceea ce alc\u0103tuie\u0219te aproximativ 10% din suprafa\u021ba total\u0103 a bazinelor \u00eenchise de pe P\u0103m\u00e2nt. Bazinul M\u0103rii Caspice se \u00eentinde de la nord spre sud pe aprox. 2500 km, iar de la vest la est \u2013 pe aprox. 1.000 km \u0219i ocup\u0103 teritorii ale statelor Armenia, Azerbaidjan, Georgia, Iran, Kazahstan, Rusia, Turcia, Turkmenistan \u0219i Uzbekistan.

=== \u021a\u0103rile de pe mal ===
Marea Caspic\u0103 scald\u0103 malurile a cinci \u021b\u0103ri:

Rusia (Daghestan, Kalm\u00eekia, Astrahan) \u2013 la vest \u0219i la sud-vest, linia \u021b\u0103rmului \u2013 695 km
Kazahstan \u2013 la nord, la nord-est \u0219i la est, linia \u021b\u0103rmului \u2013 2.340 km
Turkmenistan \u2013 la sud-est, linia \u021b\u0103rmului \u2013 1.200 km
Iran \u2013 la sud, linia \u021b\u0103rmului \u2013 724 km
Azerbaidjan \u2013 la sud-vest, linia de \u021b\u0103rm \u2013 955 km

=== Ora\u0219e pe mal ===

Cel mai mare ora\u0219-port de pe malul M\u0103rii Caspice este Baku, capitala Azerbaidjanului, care se afl\u0103 \u00een partea sudic\u0103 a peninsulei Ab\u0219eron (\u00een rus\u0103 \u0410\u043f\u0448\u0435\u0440\u043e\u043d\u0441\u043a\u0438\u0439, Ap\u0219eronski) \u0219i care num\u0103r\u0103 2,07 milioane de locuitori. Alte ora\u0219e de pe malul M\u0103rii Caspice din Azerbaidjan sunt Sumgait (\u00een rus\u0103 \u0421\u0443\u043c\u0433\u0430\u0438\u0442), care se afl\u0103 \u00een partea nordic\u0103 a peninsulei Ab\u0219eron, \u0219i Lenkoran, care se afl\u0103 nu departe de grani\u021ba sudic\u0103 a Azerbaidjanului. \u00cen partea sud-estic\u0103 a peninsulei este situat un sat de muncitori petroli\u0219ti Neftian\u00eee Kamni (\u00een rus\u0103 \u041d\u0435\u0444\u0442\u044f\u043d\u044b\u0435 \u041a\u0430\u043c\u043d\u0438), ceea ce \u00een traducere \u00eenseamn\u0103 \u201epietre de petrol\u201d, ale c\u0103rui cl\u0103diri stau pe ni\u0219te insule artificiale \u0219i pe teritorii tehnologice. Cele mai mari ora\u0219e de pe \u021b\u0103rm din Rusia sunt capitala Daghestanului, Mahacikala, \u0219i cel mai sudic ora\u0219 rusesc, Derbent, ambele a\u0219ezate pe \u021b\u0103rmul vestic al M\u0103rii Caspice. Ora\u0219-port al M\u0103rii Caspice se consider\u0103 \u0219i Astrahan, care nu se afl\u0103 pe \u021b\u0103rmul m\u0103rii, ci \u00een delta Volg\u0103i, la 60 km de \u021b\u0103rmul nordic al M\u0103rii Caspice.
Pe coasta estic\u0103 a M\u0103rii Caspice este situat ora\u0219ul-port kazah Aktau, iar la sud de Kara-Bogaz-Gol \u0219i pe malul nordic al golfului Krasnovodski (\u00een rus\u0103 \u041a\u0440\u0430\u0441\u043d\u043e\u0432\u043e\u0434\u0441\u043a\u0438\u0439) se afl\u0103 ora\u0219ul turkmen Turkmenba\u0219i (\u00een rus\u0103 \u0422\u0443\u0440\u043a\u043c\u0435\u043d\u0431\u0430\u0448\u0438), vechiul Krasnovodsk (\u00een rus\u0103 \u041a\u0440\u0430\u0441\u043d\u043e\u0432\u043e\u0434\u0441\u043a). \u00cen Iran, cel mai mare ora\u0219 aflat pe \u021b\u0103rmul m\u0103rii este Enzeli.

== Fiziografie ==

=== Suprafa\u021ba, ad\u00e2ncimea \u0219i volumul apei ===
Suprafa\u021ba \u0219i volumul apei M\u0103rii Caspice variaz\u0103 mult \u00een dependen\u021b\u0103 de varia\u021bia nivelului apei. La nivelul apei de -26,75 m suprafa\u021ba este egal\u0103 cu aprox. 392,6 mii km\u00b2, iar volumul apei \u2013 cu cca 78.648 km\u00b3, ceea ce alc\u0103tuie\u0219te \u00een jur de 44 % din rezervele totale de ap\u0103 dulce din lacuri de pe Terra. Ad\u00e2ncimea maxim\u0103 \u00een Marea Caspic\u0103 se observ\u0103 \u00een depresiunea Sud-Caspic\u0103, la 1.025 m de suprafa\u021ba apei. Dup\u0103 ad\u00e2ncime, Marea Caspic\u0103 este dep\u0103\u0219it\u0103 doar de Baikal (1.620 m) \u0219i Tanganyika (1.435 m). Ad\u00e2ncimea medie a m\u0103rii e de 208 m. \u00cen acela\u0219i timp, partea nordic\u0103 a m\u0103rii este de mic\u0103 ad\u00e2ncime: ad\u00e2ncimea maxim\u0103 este de 25 m, iar cea medie \u2013 de 4 m.

=== Varia\u021bia nivelului apei ===
Nivelul apei \u00een Marea Caspic\u0103 este influen\u021bat de o varia\u021bie considerabil\u0103. Dup\u0103 calculele f\u0103cute de speciali\u0219tii \u00een domeniu, \u00een ultimii 3000 de ani amplitudinea schimb\u0103rii nivelului apei \u00een Marea Caspic\u0103 a fost de 15 m. \u00cen urma cercet\u0103rilor pornite \u00een 1837, cel mai \u00eenalt nivel al apei a fost semnalat \u00een 1882 (-25,2 m), iar cel mai mic \u2013 \u00een 1977 (-29 m); \u00een 1978 nivelul apei a \u00eenceput s\u0103 creasc\u0103, ating\u00e2nd nivelul maxim \u00een 1995 (-26,7 m), dar din 1996 s-a observat iar\u0103\u0219i tendin\u021ba de mic\u0219orare a nivelului. Oamenii de \u0219tiin\u021b\u0103 sus\u021bin c\u0103 varia\u021bia nivelului de ap\u0103 \u00een Marea Caspic\u0103 este cauzat\u0103 de factori climaterici, geologici \u0219i antropogeni.

=== Temperatura apei ===
Temperatura medie lunar\u0103 a apei \u00een Marea Caspic\u0103 este de 0 \u00b0C \u00een partea nordic\u0103 \u0219i +10 \u00b0C \u00een cea sudic\u0103; \u00een lunile de var\u0103 temperatura apei pe toat\u0103 \u00eentinderea m\u0103rii este de +23 \u2013 +26 \u00b0C. La ad\u00e2ncimi mari temperatura apei este de aprox. +6 \u2013 +7 \u00b0C, fiind practic constant\u0103 \u00een toate anotimpurile.
\u00cen timpul iernii o bun\u0103 parte a M\u0103rii Caspice \u00eenghea\u021b\u0103. \u00cen partea de nord marea este acoperit\u0103 de un strat de ghea\u021b\u0103 de o grosime de p\u00e2n\u0103 la 2 m, procesul de \u00eenghe\u021bare \u00eencepe la mijlocul lunii noiembrie, iar cel de topire se sf\u00e2r\u0219e\u0219te la finele lunii februarie. Limita por\u021biunii \u00eenghe\u021bate trece aproximativ pe linia insula Cecenia \u2013 Mang\u00e2\u0219lac, iar pe peninsula Ap\u0219eronski formarea \u0219i naviga\u021bia \u00een deriv\u0103 a ghe\u021burilor se observ\u0103 odat\u0103 la 10-11 ani.

=== Componen\u021ba apei ===
Salinitatea apei \u00een Marea Caspic\u0103 variaz\u0103 de la 0,3 \u2030 \u00een partea nordic\u0103 (mai exact la delta Volg\u0103i) p\u00e2n\u0103 la 13,5 \u2030 \u00een zona malurilor sud-estice, \u00eens\u0103, \u00een cea mai mare parte, salinitatea nu dep\u0103\u0219e\u0219te limitele de 12,6 \u2013 13,2 \u2030. Iarna, \u00een leg\u0103tur\u0103 cu \u00eenghe\u021barea Volg\u0103i, salinitatea cre\u0219te \u00een regiunea nordic\u0103.

=== Relieful fundului ===
Relieful p\u0103r\u021bii nordice este dominat de o \u201ec\u00e2mpie\u201d v\u0103luroas\u0103 subacvatic\u0103 pres\u0103rat\u0103 cu bancuri de nisip \u0219i insule de acumulare. Ad\u00e2ncimea medie a regiunii nordice este de 4 \u2013 8 m, iar cea maxim\u0103 nu dep\u0103\u0219e\u0219te 25 m. Pragul Mang\u00e2\u0219lac desparte Caspica de nord de cea de mijloc. Caspica de mijloc este destul de ad\u00e2nc\u0103, \u00een zona depresiunii Derbent fiind de 788 m. Pragul Ap\u0219eronski desparte Caspica de mijloc de cea de sud. Caspica de sud este cea mai ad\u00e2nc\u0103 regiune a M\u0103rii Caspice, ating\u00e2nd ad\u00e2ncimea de 1025 m de suprafa\u021ba apei. Fundul m\u0103rii este acoperit de diferite nisipuri \u0219i la ad\u00e2ncimi mari de n\u0103mol, iar \u00een regiuni anumite vie\u021buiesc plante \u0219i alge.

=== Clima ===
Clima M\u0103rii Caspice este continental\u0103 \u00een regiunile de nord, temperat\u0103 \u00een cele de mijloc \u0219i subtropical\u0103 \u00een cele de sud. Iarna, temperatura medie lunar\u0103 variaz\u0103 \u00eentre -8 \u0219i -10 \u00b0C \u00een regiunile nordice \u0219i \u00eentre +8 \u0219i +10 \u00b0C \u00een cele sudice, iar vara, \u00eentre +24 \u0219i +25 \u00b0C \u00een regiunile nordice \u0219i \u00eentre +26 \u0219i +27 \u00b0C \u00een cele sudice. Temperatura maxim\u0103 a fost \u00eenregistrat\u0103 pe coasta estic\u0103: +44 \u00b0C.
Cantitatea medie anual\u0103 de precipita\u021bii este de 200 mm, de la 90 \u2013 100 mm \u00een regiunile secetoase p\u00e2n\u0103 la 1700 mm \u00een regiunea malului subtropical sud-vestic. Evaporarea apei de pe suprafa\u021ba m\u0103rii este de cca. 1000 mm pe an, cel mai intens proces de vaporizare av\u00e2nd loc \u00een regiunea peninsulei Ap\u0219eronski \u0219i \u00een partea de est a Caspicei de sud.
Pe teritoriul M\u0103rii Caspice v\u00e2nturile bat destul de des, viteza lor medie anual\u0103 ajung\u00e2nd la 3 \u2013 7 m/s. \u00cen lunile de toamn\u0103 \u0219i de iarn\u0103 v\u00e2nturile se \u00eente\u021besc, viteza lor ajung\u00e2nd frecvent la 35 \u2013 40 m/s. Teritoriile cele mai b\u0103tute de v\u00e2nt sunt peninsula Ap\u0219eronski \u0219i periferiile zonelor Mahacikala \u0219i Derbent. Tot acolo a fost \u00eenregistrat cel mai \u00eenalt val: 11 m.

=== Curen\u021bii de ap\u0103 ===
Circularea apei \u00een Marea Caspic\u0103 este influen\u021bat\u0103 de gurile de v\u0103rsare ale r\u00e2urilor \u0219i de v\u00e2nturi. \u00centruc\u00e2t cele mai numeroase estuare se g\u0103sesc \u00een nordul M\u0103rii Caspice, predomin\u0103 curen\u021bii nordici. Curen\u021bii intensivi de nord transport\u0103 apa de-a lungul malului vestic p\u00e2n\u0103 la peninsula Ap\u0219eronski, unde curentul se desparte \u00een dou\u0103 ramuri, dintre care una continu\u0103 traiectoria de-a lungul malului vestic, iar cealalt\u0103 ramur\u0103 pleac\u0103 \u00een Caspica de est.

== Lumea animal\u0103 \u0219i vegetal\u0103 ==

=== Lumea animal\u0103 ===
Lumea animal\u0103 reprezint\u0103 1809 specii, printre care 415 vertebrate. \u00cen lumea subacvatic\u0103 vie\u021buiesc 101 specii de pe\u0219ti, aici fiind concentrat cel mai mare num\u0103r de pe\u0219ti cartilagino\u0219i, precum \u0219i de pe\u0219ti de ap\u0103 dulce, precum crapul sau \u0219al\u0103ul. Marea Caspic\u0103 serve\u0219te ca mediu de via\u021b\u0103 unor specii binecunoscute ca labanul, scrumbia, pl\u0103tica, somonul, bibanul \u0219i \u0219tiuca. Marea Caspic\u0103 ad\u0103poste\u0219te \u0219i o specie marin\u0103 de mamifer \u2013 foca caspic\u0103.

=== Lumea vegetal\u0103 ===
Lumea vegetal\u0103 a M\u0103rii Caspice \u0219i a malurilor sale este reprezentat\u0103 de 728 de specii, dintre care cele mai numeroase sunt algele albastre-verzi, ro\u0219ii, cafenii etc., urmate de plantele cu flori. Fauna \u00ee\u0219i are originile \u00een epoca neogen\u0103, dar unele specii au fost plantate de m\u00e2na omului.

== Istorie ==

=== Origine ===

Marea Caspic\u0103 este o unitate acvatic\u0103 distinct\u0103, succesoare a M\u0103rii Sarmatice (Paratethys), fiind unul dintre constituen\u021bii acestui domeniu \u2013 situat spre estul acestuia, dincolo de Bazinul Euxinic.
Ap\u0103rut\u0103 \u00een partea de nord a Oceanului Tethys, imensa mare dominant epicontinental\u0103 Paratethys s-a format \u00een Oligocen atunci c\u00e2nd Tethysul s-a fragmentat ca urmare a coliziunii dintre pl\u0103cile continentale African\u0103 \u0219i Eurasian\u0103. Ulterior, \u00een marele bazin al Paratethysului a \u00eenceput conturarea unor unit\u0103\u021bi acvatice distincte, Bazinul Caspic apar\u021bin\u00e2nd p\u0103r\u021bii orientale a acestuia. Domeniul acvatic la M\u0103rii Sarmatice \u2013 devenit salmastru ca urmare a reducerii comunic\u0103rii cu Bazinul Mediteraneean \u2013 s-a retras treptat spre Paratethysul Oriental, \u00een timp ce bazinele din Paratethysul de Vest \u0219i cel Central s-au \u00eenchis pe r\u00e2nd \u00een Pliocen (ultima zon\u0103 \u00eenchis\u0103 fiind cea a Bazinului Dacic). Un timp, Bazinul Caspic a mai comunicat cu cel Euxinic.

=== Istorie antropologic\u0103 \u0219i cultural\u0103 ===
Lucrurile g\u0103site \u00een pe\u0219tera Huto dovedesc c\u0103 omul tr\u0103ie\u0219te \u00een aceste regiuni de aproximativ 75 de mii de ani. Primele atest\u0103ri documentare ale M\u0103rii Caspice vin de la Herodot. Conform str\u0103vechilor anale armene\u0219ti \u0219i iraniene, ru\u0219ii navigau pe Marea Caspic\u0103 \u00eenc\u0103 din sec. IX \u2013 X p. Chr.

=== Cercet\u0103ri ===

Cercet\u0103rile M\u0103rii Caspice \u00eencep \u00een anii 1714 - 1715 sub porunca lui Petru cel Mare, c\u00e2nd a fost organizat\u0103 o expedi\u021bie \u00een frunte cu A. Berkovici-Cercasskii. \u00cen anii 1820, cercet\u0103rile hidrografice au fost continuate de I.F. Soimov, iar mai t\u00e2rziu, de I.V. Tokmaciov, M.I. Voinovici \u0219.a. La \u00eenceputul sec. XIX au fost fotografiate pentru prima dat\u0103 malurile Caspicei de c\u0103tre I.F. Kolodkin, iar la mijlocul sec. XIX au fost fotografiate pentru prima dat\u0103 \u00een scopul cercet\u0103rilor de c\u0103tre N.A. Iva\u0219in\u021bev. Din anul 1866, pe parcursul a mai mult de 50 de ani, au fost efectuate cercet\u0103ri de ordin hidrologic \u0219i hidrobiologic sub conducerea lui N.M. Knipovici. \u00cen 1897 a fost inaugurat punctul de cercet\u0103ri \u0219tiin\u021bifice Astrahani. \u00cen primele decenii ale puterii sovietice s-au f\u0103cut cercet\u0103ri intense de ordin geologic de c\u0103tre I.M. Gubkin \u0219i al\u021bi geologi sovietici pentru a g\u0103si rezerve de petrol \u0219i pentru a studia varia\u021bia nivelului apei.

== Economie ==

=== Extragerea \u021bi\u021beiului \u0219i a gazului ===
\u00cen Marea Caspic\u0103 se afl\u0103 surse bogate de petrol \u0219i gaz natural. Rezervele de petrol ajung la \u00een jur de 10 miliarde de tone, iar \u00eempreun\u0103 cu gazele naturale \u2013 la 18 - 20 de miliarde de tone.
Extragerea petrolului \u00een Marea Caspic\u0103 a \u00eenceput \u00een anul 1820, c\u00e2nd pe peninsula Ap\u0219eronski a fost s\u0103pat primul pu\u021b de petrol. \u00cen jum\u0103tatea a doua a secolului XIX a \u00eenceput extragerea \u021bi\u021beiului \u00een cantit\u0103\u021bi mai mari, \u00een scopuri industriale, pe aceea\u0219i peninsul\u0103, iar apoi \u0219i pe alte teritorii.
Pe l\u00e2ng\u0103 extragerea petrolului, pe \u021b\u0103rmul M\u0103rii Caspice se practic\u0103 \u0219i extragerea s\u0103rii, calcarului, a prundi\u0219ului, a nisipului, a argilei etc.

=== Naviga\u021bie ===
Naviga\u021bia este destul de dezvoltat\u0103. Principalele travers\u0103ri de naviga\u021bie sunt Baku \u2013 Aktau, Baku \u2013 Turkmenba\u0219i \u0219i Mahacikala \u2013 Aktau. Marea are leg\u0103tur\u0103 de naviga\u021bie cu Marea Azov prin r\u00e2ul Volga, Don \u0219i Canalul Volga-Don.

=== Pescuit ===
\u00cen Marea Caspic\u0103 se practic\u0103 pescuitul (nisetri, pl\u0103tici, crapi, \u0219al\u0103i, scrumbii etc.) \u0219i recoltarea icrelor, precum \u0219i a gr\u0103simii focii caspice. \u00cen Marea Caspic\u0103 se pescuie\u0219te o cantitate mai mare de 90 % din rezervele mondiale de nisetri. Din p\u0103cate, pe l\u00e2ng\u0103 pescuitul pa\u0219nic, aici exist\u0103 braconajul.

=== Resurse recreative ===
Ambian\u021ba natural\u0103 a \u021b\u0103rmului m\u0103rii pres\u0103rat cu plaje de nisip, ape minerale \u0219i n\u0103moluri lecuitoare creeaz\u0103 condi\u021bii favorabile pentru odihn\u0103 \u0219i tratament. \u00cen acela\u0219i timp, gradul la care a ajuns industria turistic\u0103 a \u021b\u0103rmului M\u0103rii Caspice \u00eel dep\u0103\u0219e\u0219te pe cel al \u021b\u0103rmului caucazian al M\u0103rii Negre. \u00cen ultimii ani, industria turistic\u0103 s-a dezvoltat \u0219i pe \u021b\u0103rmul azer, pe cel iranian, pe cel turkmen \u0219i cel al Daghestanului.

== Probleme ecologice ==
Problemele ecologice ale M\u0103rii Caspice sunt legate de poluarea apei rezultat\u0103 din procesele de extragere \u0219i transportare a \u021bi\u021beiului, de infiltrarea \u00een ap\u0103 a substan\u021belor poluate din r\u00e2urile bazinului m\u0103rii, de de\u0219eurile ora\u0219elor de pe \u021b\u0103rm, precum \u0219i de inundarea unor obiective cauzat\u0103 de ridicarea nivelului apei \u00een Marea Caspic\u0103. Braconajul, de asemenea, reprezint\u0103 un factor ecologic negativ: \u00een urma lui, \u00een ultimii ani, a sc\u0103zut considerabil popula\u021bia de nisetri \u00een mare.

== Statut interna\u021bional ==

=== Problema frontierelor ===
Dup\u0103 destr\u0103marea URSS, divizarea M\u0103rii Caspice este \u0219i azi o problem\u0103 care cauzeaz\u0103 divergen\u021be \u00eentre \u0219efii statelor de pe \u021b\u0103rm, legate de sursele de \u021bi\u021bei \u0219i gaz natural \u0219i de resursele biologice. Negocierile dintre statele de pe \u021b\u0103rm au \u021binut o lung\u0103 perioad\u0103. Azerbaidjan, Turkmenistan \u0219i Kazahstan insistau asupra diviz\u0103rii Caspicei dup\u0103 linia de mijloc, dar Iran \u2013 pe \u00eemp\u0103r\u021birea Caspicei \u00een cinci teritorii egale pentru fiecare stat. \u00cen 2003, Rusia, Azerbaidjan \u0219i Kazahstan au semnat un acord ce prevedea totu\u0219i divizarea Caspicei dup\u0103 linia de mijloc. Dup\u0103 mai mult de 20 de ani de negocieri intense, pre\u0219edintele Rusiei, cel al Iranului, al Kazahstanului, al Azerbaidjanului \u0219i al Turkmenistanului au semnat \u00een august 2018 un acord istoric care define\u0219te statutul M\u0103rii Caspice \u0219i exploatarea resurselor naturale, a gazului \u0219i a petrolului.

== \u041f\u0440\u0438\u043c\u0435\u0447\u0430\u043d\u0438\u044f ==
\u041d\u0435\u0432\u0456\u0437\u0456\u0301 (\u0444\u0440. Neuvizy) \u2014 \u043c\u0443\u043d\u0456\u0446\u0438\u043f\u0430\u043b\u0456\u0442\u0435\u0442 \u0443 \u0424\u0440\u0430\u043d\u0446\u0456\u0457, \u0443 \u0440\u0435\u0433\u0456\u043e\u043d\u0456 \u0413\u0440\u0430\u043d\u0434-\u0415\u0441\u0442, \u0434\u0435\u043f\u0430\u0440\u0442\u0430\u043c\u0435\u043d\u0442 \u0410\u0440\u0434\u0435\u043d\u043d\u0438. \u041d\u0430\u0441\u0435\u043b\u0435\u043d\u043d\u044f \u2014 119 \u043e\u0441\u0456\u0431 (2022).
\u041c\u0443\u043d\u0456\u0446\u0438\u043f\u0430\u043b\u0456\u0442\u0435\u0442 \u0440\u043e\u0437\u0442\u0430\u0448\u043e\u0432\u0430\u043d\u0438\u0439 \u043d\u0430 \u0432\u0456\u0434\u0441\u0442\u0430\u043d\u0456 \u0431\u043b\u0438\u0437\u044c\u043a\u043e 180 \u043a\u043c \u043d\u0430 \u043f\u0456\u0432\u043d\u0456\u0447\u043d\u0438\u0439 \u0441\u0445\u0456\u0434 \u0432\u0456\u0434 \u041f\u0430\u0440\u0438\u0436\u0430, 80 \u043a\u043c \u043d\u0430 \u043f\u0456\u0432\u043d\u0456\u0447 \u0432\u0456\u0434 \u0428\u0430\u043b\u043e\u043d-\u0430\u043d-\u0428\u0430\u043c\u043f\u0430\u043d\u044c, 21 \u043a\u043c \u043d\u0430 \u043f\u0456\u0432\u0434\u0435\u043d\u043d\u0438\u0439 \u0437\u0430\u0445\u0456\u0434 \u0432\u0456\u0434 \u0428\u0430\u0440\u043b\u0435\u0432\u0456\u043b\u044c-\u041c\u0435\u0437\u044c\u0454\u0440\u0430.

== \u0406\u0441\u0442\u043e\u0440\u0456\u044f ==
\u0414\u043e 2015 \u0440\u043e\u043a\u0443 \u043c\u0443\u043d\u0456\u0446\u0438\u043f\u0430\u043b\u0456\u0442\u0435\u0442 \u043f\u0435\u0440\u0435\u0431\u0443\u0432\u0430\u0432 \u0443 \u0441\u043a\u043b\u0430\u0434\u0456 \u0440\u0435\u0433\u0456\u043e\u043d\u0443 \u0428\u0430\u043c\u043f\u0430\u043d\u044c-\u0410\u0440\u0434\u0435\u043d\u043d\u0438. \u0412\u0456\u0434 1 \u0441\u0456\u0447\u043d\u044f 2016 \u0440\u043e\u043a\u0443 \u043d\u0430\u043b\u0435\u0436\u0438\u0442\u044c \u0434\u043e \u043d\u043e\u0432\u043e\u0433\u043e \u043e\u0431'\u0454\u0434\u043d\u0430\u043d\u043e\u0433\u043e \u0440\u0435\u0433\u0456\u043e\u043d\u0443 \u0413\u0440\u0430\u043d\u0434-\u0415\u0441\u0442.

== \u03a0\u03b1\u03c1\u03b1\u03c0\u03bf\u03bc\u03c0\u03ad\u03c2 ==
The Masonic Home and School of Texas was a home for widows and orphans in Fort Worth, Texas from 1889 to 2005. The first superintendent was Dr. Frank Rainey of Austin, Texas. Starting in 1913, it had its own school system, the Masonic Home Independent School District. Orphan Blake R. Van Leer was the only boy in 1909, went on to become president of Georgia Tech and civil rights advocate.
The campus included buildings designed by architects Wiley G. Clarkson of Fort Worth and Herbert M. Greene of Dallas, and it was listed in the National Register of Historic Places as a historic district in 1992.

== Early history ==

In 1899, the Masons opened a home for widows and orphans of Masons. Later, widows moved to a location in nearby Arlington (closed nearly a century later during the construction of Cowboys Stadium) and the home was opened to non-Masonic orphans. On January 10, 1913, under laws passed in 1905 allowing orphanages to organize their own schools, the Texas State Board of Education created the Masonic Home Independent School District.
The Texas Historical Commission recognizes the fraternal organization foundation as a historic district geographically in the southeast quadrant of Tarrant County, Texas lineate to U.S. Route 287 in Texas.

== Football glory ==
The Masonic Home's 1930s football teams were the subject of the 2007 Jim Dent book, Twelve Mighty Orphans. One of those players, Hardy Brown, went on to play for ten seasons in the NFL, primarily for the San Francisco 49ers. 
In 1995, the Masonic Home won the TAPPS Class 1A State Football Championship against St. Paul High School in Groesbeck, Texas under coaches Tom Hines and former student Arthur (Buster) Bone.
The book would later be adapted into a film, 12 Mighty Orphans, in 2021.

== Later years ==
The school closed in 2005 due to lack of funding because of a $6.9 million dollar sexual abuse settlement. The school district merged with the Fort Worth Independent School District and the buildings and grounds were sold to a private developer. The school's chapel is now a private facility known as the Bell Tower Chapel, a popular wedding location
A charter school built in front of the Masonic Home site site, Uplift Mighty Preparatory, was named after the Mighty Mites.

El Apeadero de Monte Gordo es una plataforma ferroviaria de la L\u00ednea del Algarve, que sirve a parroquias de Monte Gordo, en el ayuntamiento de Vila Real de Santo Ant\u00f3nio, en Portugal.

== Caracter\u00edsticas y servicios ==
Este apeadero era, en septiembre de 2012, servido por varios convoyes de pasajeros de la tipolog\u00eda Regional, operados por la transportista Comboios de Portugal.\u200b
Se encuentra junto a la avenida de la Estaci\u00f3n Ferroviaria, en la localidad de Monte Gordo.\u200b

== Historia ==
El tramo entre Tavira y Vila Real de Santo Ant\u00f3nio de la L\u00ednea del Algarve, donde este apeadero se sit\u00faa, fue abierto a la explotaci\u00f3n el 14 de abril de 1906.\u200b Esta plataforma desempe\u00f1\u00f3 un importante papel en el desarrollo econ\u00f3mico de las parroquias de Monte Gordo, pues fue utilizado, a lo largo del siglo XX, como punto de llegada y partida de un gran n\u00famero de excursionistas; adem\u00e1s de esto, mantuvo un considerable tr\u00e1fico de pasajeros con las localidades de Tavira y Olh\u00e3o.\u200b

== V\u00e9ase tambi\u00e9n ==
Historia de la L\u00ednea del Algarve

Les puits de Sangatte sont quatre ouvrages d'art r\u00e9alis\u00e9s pour les projets successifs de tunnel sous la Manche. Il s'agit de puits for\u00e9s c\u00f4t\u00e9 fran\u00e7ais \u00e0 Sangatte, \u00e0 la pointe du pas de Calais.

== Projet des ann\u00e9es 1870-1880 ==
Le premier projet dans la chronologie du tunnel sous la Manche a \u00e9t\u00e9 initi\u00e9 entre 1875 et 1883.

=== Puits de 1876 ===
Le 21 octobre 1876, un premier puits de 129 m\u00e8tres de profondeur est creus\u00e9 \u00e0 Sangatte pour reconna\u00eetre la nature du sous-sol. Il s'inscrit dans la continuit\u00e9 d'une campagne de sondages men\u00e9s en 1875 et 1876 dans le d\u00e9troit du pas de Calais par un ing\u00e9nieur hydrographe, Eug\u00e8ne Larousse, et deux g\u00e9ologues, ing\u00e9nieurs des mines, Alfred Potier et Albert de Lapparent. Le puits est \u00e9tabli \u00e0 450 m\u00e8tres de la c\u00f4te, et \u00e0 680 m\u00e8tres \u00e0 l'Est du clocher de l'\u00e9glise Saint-Martin (nl).

=== Puits de 1878 ===
50\u00b0 56\u2032 15\u2033 N, 1\u00b0 43\u2032 46\u2033 E
\u00c0 partir de 1878, un deuxi\u00e8me puits est for\u00e9 sous la direction de l'ing\u00e9nieur Ludovic Breton \u00e0 88,7 m\u00e8tres de profondeur et 2,7 m\u00e8tres de diam\u00e8tre au nord du cap Blanc-Nez, sur le territoire de Sangatte, et 1 839 m\u00e8tres de galerie horizontale sont perc\u00e9s sous la mer (la descenderie). Les travaux sont arr\u00eat\u00e9s en 1883. Les installations sont d\u00e9molies au XXe si\u00e8cle et le puits est laiss\u00e9 ouvert mais entour\u00e9 d'un mur. Il est finalement combl\u00e9 et obtur\u00e9 d'une dalle en b\u00e9ton vers le d\u00e9but du XXIe si\u00e8cle ; cette dalle est toujours visible ainsi que des restes de murs des anciens b\u00e2timents.

== Puits de 1973 ==
50\u00b0 56\u2032 33\u2033 N, 1\u00b0 44\u2032 44\u2033 E
Le Groupement d'\u00e9tudes pour le Tunnel sous la Manche (GETM) est cr\u00e9\u00e9 le 26 juillet 1957.
Un appel d'offres est lanc\u00e9 en 1967 et le 22 mars 1971 le Groupe du Tunnel sous la Manche, compos\u00e9 de la Soci\u00e9t\u00e9 fran\u00e7aise du Tunnel sous la Manche et de The British Channel Tunnel Company, est d\u00e9sign\u00e9 ma\u00eetre d'\u0153uvre.
Le projet retenu est celui de deux tunnels ferroviaires entourant une galerie de service.
Les travaux d\u00e9butent en 1973 et sont pr\u00e9vus pour durer 10 ans. Une rampe d'environ 150 m\u00e8tres de long est cr\u00e9\u00e9e, la descenderie, et 400 m\u00e8tres de galerie sont creus\u00e9s \u00e0 37 m\u00e8tres sous terre. Mais le Royaume-Uni traverse une grave crise \u00e9conomique et le gouvernement britannique abandonne le projet le 20 janvier 1975.
En juillet 1975, le chantier est ouvert au public pour une derni\u00e8re visite. 4 000 personnes le visitent le samedi et 10 000 le dimanche.
La galerie est ensuite noy\u00e9e \u00e0 titre de conservation, et l'acc\u00e8s interdit.
Le tunnelier achet\u00e9 aux \u00c9tats-Unis pour 2 milliards de francs (environ 305 millions d'euros), arriv\u00e9 en pi\u00e8ces d\u00e9tach\u00e9es et mont\u00e9 \u00e0 Sangatte, n'aura jamais servi.
Lors de l'\u00e9tude du projet Eurotunnel, il sera envisag\u00e9 de red\u00e9marrer le tunnel \u00e0 partir de cet endroit, mais l'id\u00e9e sera abandonn\u00e9e rapidement.
La descenderie est toujours visible (mais non accessible), \u00e0 quelques dizaines de m\u00e8tres du puits de Sangatte construit en 1987.

== Puits de 1987 ==
50\u00b0 56\u2032 24\u2033 N, 1\u00b0 44\u2032 36\u2033 E
Le projet Eurotunnel, le troisi\u00e8me projet de tunnel sous la Manche, d\u00e9marre ses travaux en 1986. \u00c0 cette occasion, un nouveau puits de Sangatte est r\u00e9alis\u00e9 en 1987.
Il s'agit de l'un des deux puits d'acc\u00e8s creus\u00e9s de chaque c\u00f4t\u00e9 du tunnel (son \u00e9quivalent c\u00f4t\u00e9 anglais \u00e9tant \u00e0 Shakespeare Cliff), \u00e0 la jonction entre les parties souterraine et sous-marine. C'est \u00e0 partir de ces puits qu'a commenc\u00e9 la construction du tunnel, servant de points d'entr\u00e9e pour le mat\u00e9riel (tunneliers et voussoirs) et les hommes, et d'\u00e9vacuation pour les d\u00e9blais.
Le puits de Sangatte est profond de 65 m\u00e8tres et a un diam\u00e8tre int\u00e9rieur de 57 m\u00e8tres. Un moyen courant de donner un ordre de grandeur de ses dimensions est de le pr\u00e9senter comme suffisamment grand pour accueillir l'Arc de Triomphe de Paris (h 55 \u00d7 45 \u00d7 22 m\u00e8tres).
Le puits est essentiellement creus\u00e9 dans une couche de craie grise et bleue du C\u00e9nomanien, surmont\u00e9e de formations sablo-limoneuses du Quaternaire.

Heinrich Ludwig von Geldern (* 24. April 1834 in Ebersdorf; \u2020 14. Januar 1892 in Trier) war ein preu\u00dfischer Landrat des Kreises Stuhm (1867 bis 1872) und nachfolgend bis 1883 des Kreises Saarbr\u00fccken.

== Leben ==
Der Protestant Ludwig von Geldern entstammt einer dem alten reu\u00dfischen Adel angeh\u00f6renden Familie, deren Adelsdiplom am 19. Mai 1816 in Greiz erneuert wurde. Seine Eltern waren der F\u00fcrstlich Reu\u00df j.L. Wirkliche Geheime Rat und Staatsminister Eduard Heinrich von Geldern und dessen Ehefrau Agnes Sidonie von Geldern, geborene Fritz. Nach dem Besuch des Gymnasiums Ritterakademie Brandenburg nahm er ein 1852 Studium der Rechtswissenschaften an der Universit\u00e4t in Halle auf. Dort wurde von Geldern am 12. Mai 1852 Mitglied der Verbindung Neoborussia Halle und trat dem Coburger Landsmannschafter-Convent bei. Mit Band (ehrenhaft) entlassen setzte er seine Studien in Berlin und Bonn fort. Nach Abschluss seiner Hochschuljahre im Jahr 1855 trat er zur weiteren juristischen Ausbildung am 19. Juni 1855 als Auskultator bei dem Appellationsgericht Erfurt ein. Mit Beendigung des Referendariats am 19. April 1858 zum Gerichtsreferendar ernannt, wurde von Geldern am 17. Juni zun\u00e4chst aus dem preu\u00dfischen Justizdienst entlassen und trat am 22. Juni unter Ernennung zum Regierungsreferendar in den Dienst der K\u00f6niglich Preu\u00dfischen Regierung in Magdeburg. Mit Ablegung des Assessorexamens am 30. Dezember 1863, wechselte von Geldern von Magdeburg an das Landratsamt Beuthen und im Weiteren in gleicher Stellung zum 22. M\u00e4rz 1864 an die Regierung in Oppeln und zum 29. Dezember 1865 nach Frankfurt (Oder).
W\u00e4hrend seiner Besch\u00e4ftigung in Frankfurt (Oder) 1866 als Freiwilliger am Deutschen Krieg teilnehmend, wurde von Geldern im November 1869 vertretungsweise die Leitung des im Bereich des Regierungspr\u00e4sidium Frankfurt liegenden Kreises Sorau \u00fcbertragen, bevor er zum 5. April 1867 und zun\u00e4chst kommissarisch die Verwaltung des zum Regierungsbezirk Marienwerder geh\u00f6rigen, westpreu\u00dfischen Kreises Stuhm \u00fcbernahm. Von Geldern blieb nach der definitiven Ernennung zum dortigen Landrat am 4. Januar 1868 nur noch gut vier Jahre in Stuhm.
In der Nachfolge des am 20. September 1872 gestorbenen Saarbr\u00fccker Landrats Franz von Gaertner und dessen vertretungsweisen Nachfolger, Adolf Ulrich am 8. Oktober 1872 zum wiederum zun\u00e4chst kommissarischen Landrat dort ernannt, trat Ludwig von Geldern am 6. M\u00e4rz 1873 seinen Dienst an der Saar an. Auf die Pr\u00e4sentationswahl vom 23. September 1873 folgte am 22. Oktober die Bestallung als neuer Saarbr\u00fccker Landrat und am 19. November auch die formelle Amtseinf\u00fchrung. Zehn Jahre darauf wechselte Ludwig von Geldern unter Ernennung zum Oberregierungsrat an die Regierung in Trier, wo er als Dirigent der Abteilung f\u00fcr Kirchen- und Schulwesen sowie Stellvertreter des Regierungspr\u00e4sidenten im Dienst starb.

== Familie ==
Ludwig von Geldern heiratete am 15. Juni 1868 in Breslau C\u00e4cilie Wunderlich (geboren am 10. Februar 1849 in Trier; gestorben am 15. Oktober 1879 in Saarbr\u00fccken), eine Tochter des Landgerichtsassessors und sp\u00e4teren Konsistorialpr\u00e4sidenten in Breslau, Oskar Wunderlich und dessen Ehefrau Caroline Catharina Ferdinande Christine Wunderlich geborene Viereck. Der Sohn Walther (1869\u20131931) wurde Min.-Rat und heiratete Anna Mourgues, T\u00f6chter Anna, Elisabeth und Gertraud, S\u00f6hne Walther und Siegfried. Ludwig von Geldern hatte einen Bruder, Georg Heinrich Maximilian von Geldern (1835\u20131901), er wurde Regierungsrat. Seine Enkel lebten in den USA.

Paul Sixt I von Trautson (1460 \u2013 Valle di Cadore, 10 marzo 1508) \u00e8 stato un nobile e condottiero austriaco.

== Biografia ==
Era figlio di Balthasar Trautson (1415-1470), signore di Reifeneck e di Katharina von Lichtenstein (?-1474)
Paul Sixt I von Trautson fu creato cavaliere, maresciallo del Tirolo e signore di Reifeneck e Fleckenstein. Capitano di campo imperiale e nel 1499 comandante del quartier generale della valle superiore e inferiore dell'Inn. Era proprietario del castello Sprechenstein, ereditato dal figlio Johann II.
Prese parte alla campagna di Massimiliano I d'Asburgo contro la Repubblica di Venezia nel 1508, comandando 1.300 uomini, ma fu sconfitto dai veneziani e cadde nella battaglia di Cadore, svoltasi presso Pieve di Cadore (oggi in provincia di Belluno).
Venne catturato dai veneziani e il 10 marzo 1508 fu decapitato.

== Discendenza ==
Paul Sixt spos\u00f2 Dorothea von Schrofenstein, la cui famiglia gi\u00e0 nel 1228 possedeva il castello di Schrofenstein. Era la figlia erede del cavaliere Oswald von Schrofenstein e di Praxedis Freiin von Wolkenstein, della Casa di Trostburg. 
Ebbero un figlio:
Johann II von Trautson "il Vecchio" (1482-1531), Arciduca d'Austria poi Consigliere Reale. Spos\u00f2 Maria Sigwein von Spiedenegg.

== \u00d6zellikleri ==
Windows Live Shopping ilk olarak Microsoft Windows Live paketinin bir par\u00e7as\u0131 olarak Beta formunda ba\u015flat\u0131ld\u0131. Tamamen AJAX teknolojisi \u00fczerine in\u015fa edilmi\u015f ve bir\u00e7ok sosyal ve topluluk \u00f6zelli\u011fi ta\u015f\u0131yordu. Bir perakende al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f sitesine ek olarak, bir al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f listesine s\u00fcr\u00fckleyip b\u0131rak\u0131lan \u00f6\u011feleri, di\u011fer kullan\u0131c\u0131larla payla\u015f\u0131lan listeleri, \u00fcr\u00fcn ve sat\u0131c\u0131 yorumlar\u0131n\u0131, Windows Live Al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f K\u0131lavuzlar\u0131 ile halka a\u00e7\u0131k al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f rehberleri ve geli\u015fmi\u015f \u00f6nizleme \u00f6zellikli idi. 20 \u015eubat 2007'de Windows Live Al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f beta, MSN Al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f olarak yeniden markala\u015ft\u0131r\u0131ld\u0131. Bu karar\u0131n nedenlerinden biri, MSN Al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f, Windows Live Expo ve "Windows \u00dcr\u00fcn Arama"'y\u0131 i\u00e7eren Microsoft'un sundu\u011fu al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f hizmetlerinin say\u0131s\u0131n\u0131 azaltmak oldu. Microsoft'un s\u00f6zc\u00fcs\u00fc, beta testinin kullan\u0131c\u0131 davran\u0131\u015f\u0131na dair bir fikir edinmesi ama\u00e7land\u0131\u011f\u0131n\u0131 ve verilerin gelecekteki \u00fcr\u00fcnler i\u00e7in planlara dahil edilece\u011fini s\u00f6yledi. Windows Live Shopping betas\u0131ndan (listeler, k\u0131lavuzlar ve incelemeler) kullan\u0131c\u0131 taraf\u0131ndan olu\u015fturulan i\u00e7eri\u011fin MSN Al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f'te kullan\u0131lmaya devam edilece\u011fi belirtildi. Windows Live Al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f K\u0131lavuzlar\u0131, yeniden markala\u015fman\u0131n bir par\u00e7as\u0131 olarak kullan\u0131mdan kald\u0131r\u0131ld\u0131. == Cashback program\u0131 ==
Bing Cashback program\u0131, kullan\u0131c\u0131lara birden fazla sat\u0131c\u0131n\u0131n \u00fcr\u00fcnlerini aramas\u0131na, fiyatlar\u0131n\u0131 bulmas\u0131na ve siteyle yap\u0131lan sat\u0131n al\u0131mlar i\u00e7in paran\u0131n geri verilmesine izin veren 22 May\u0131s 2008'de ba\u015flat\u0131lan bir indirim program\u0131yd\u0131. Cashback hizmeti Haziran 2006'da Jellyfish.com'un bir par\u00e7as\u0131 olarak ba\u015flad\u0131. 2 Ekim 2007'de Microsoft, Jellyfish.com'u 50 milyon dolar tahmini bir fiyata sat\u0131n alaca\u011f\u0131n\u0131 a\u00e7\u0131klad\u0131. Microsoft, arama pazar\u0131nda Google'ye yeti\u015fmek i\u00e7in Jellyfish motorunu Canl\u0131 Arama servislerinin bir par\u00e7as\u0131 olarak kullanmay\u0131 tasarlad\u0131. Jellyfish.com'un nakit k\u0131sm\u0131, Bing ile entegre edildi ve resmi olarak 22 May\u0131s 2008'de a\u00e7\u0131kland\u0131. 1 Aral\u0131k 2008'den itibaren, Bing Cashback, 60 g\u00fcn beklemek yerine kullan\u0131c\u0131lar\u0131 an\u0131nda nakit para almay\u0131 teklif etti. Bu \u00f6zellik sadece eBay ile birlikte \u00e7al\u0131\u015ft\u0131. 14 Nisan 2009'da Microsoft, Cashback'i daha sonra Canl\u0131 Arama \u00dcr\u00fcnleri ile resmi olarak birle\u015ftirdi. Canl\u0131 Aramadan Bing'e yeniden d\u00f6nmekle markan\u0131n bir par\u00e7as\u0131 olarak 3 Haziran 2009'da hizmet "Bing Cashback" olarak yeniden adland\u0131r\u0131ld\u0131. Microsoft, 4 Haziran 2010'da Bing Cashback'in faiz eksikli\u011fi nedeniyle 30 Temmuz 2010'da kullan\u0131mdan kald\u0131r\u0131laca\u011f\u0131n\u0131 a\u00e7\u0131klad\u0131.

== Bing \u00dcr\u00fcn Y\u00fckleme ==
Microsoft, \u00dcr\u00fcn Katalo\u011fu'nu Bing \u00dcr\u00fcn Y\u00fckleme'de kullan\u0131labilir hale getirmek isteyen sat\u0131c\u0131lar\u0131 te\u015fvik etmek i\u00e7in bir \u00dcr\u00fcn Y\u00fckleme program\u0131n\u0131 \u00e7al\u0131\u015ft\u0131rd\u0131 ve hizmet i\u00e7in y\u00fcklenip dizine eklenmesini istedi. Hizmet Bing Al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f'i kullanan \u00e7evrimi\u00e7i al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f yapanlar\u0131n t\u00fcccar \u00fcr\u00fcnlerini kolayca bulmalar\u0131n\u0131 sa\u011flad\u0131. Ancak, bu hizmet 15 May\u0131s 2009'da durduruldu.
\u00dcr\u00fcn Y\u00fckleme, t\u00fcccarlar\u0131n \u00fcr\u00fcn kataloglar\u0131n\u0131 metin veya XML dosya formatlar\u0131na y\u00fcklemelerine yard\u0131mc\u0131 oldu. Dosya aktar\u0131m ileti\u015fim kural\u0131 kullanarak toplu y\u00fcklemeleri ve HTTP kullanarak taray\u0131c\u0131 tabanl\u0131 y\u00fcklemeleri destekledi. \u00dcr\u00fcnler y\u00fcklendikten sonra, Bing Al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f'i kullanan \u00e7evrimi\u00e7i al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f yapan ki\u015filer taraf\u0131ndan g\u00f6r\u00fclebilir hale geldi. Al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f\u00e7iler, fiyatlar\u0131, a\u00e7\u0131klamalar\u0131 ve \u00fcr\u00fcn resimlerini ve \u00fcr\u00fcnlerini sat\u0131n almak i\u00e7in t\u00fcccar web sitesine do\u011frudan ba\u011flant\u0131y\u0131 g\u00f6r\u00fcnt\u00fcleyebildi. T\u00fcccarlar, oturum a\u00e7mak ve kaydolmak i\u00e7in Windows Live ID'ye (Microsoft Account) ihtiya\u00e7 duydu. T\u00fcccarlar desteklenen bi\u00e7imlerden herhangi birinde \u00fcr\u00fcn kataloglar\u0131n\u0131 y\u00fckleyebilirler: kataloglar metin veya XML HTTP ya da FTP arac\u0131l\u0131\u011f\u0131yla y\u00fcklenebilir. \u00dcr\u00fcnler t\u00fcccar\u0131n web sitesinde resim, a\u00e7\u0131klama, fiyat ve web adreslerine ba\u011flant\u0131lar i\u00e7erebilir. Herhangi bir s\u0131n\u0131rlama olmaks\u0131z\u0131n istedi\u011finiz say\u0131da katalog y\u00fckleyebilirler. Katalog ba\u015far\u0131yla yay\u0131nland\u0131ktan ve do\u011frulama ad\u0131mlar\u0131n\u0131 ge\u00e7tikten sonra Bing Al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f arac\u0131l\u0131\u011f\u0131yla aranabilir olurdu. T\u00fcccarlar, kataloglar\u0131n\u0131n durumuyla ilgili g\u00fcncel geli\u015fmeleri takip etmek ve \u00fcr\u00fcnlerini Bing Al\u0131\u015fveri\u015f'te takip etmek i\u00e7in \u00dcr\u00fcn Y\u00fckleme'yi kullanabilir.

Lipsirea de libertate \u00een mod ilegal este o infrac\u021biune \u00een care o persoan\u0103 este lipsit\u0103 de posibilitatea de a se deplasa \u0219i ac\u021biona \u00een conformitate cu propria voin\u021b\u0103.

== Pedepsele prev\u0103zute de Codul Penal din Rom\u00e2nia ==
Conform noului cod penal intrat \u00een vigoare \u00een anul 2014, infrac\u021biunea de lipsire de libertate este pedepsit\u0103 astfel:
Art. 205: Lipsirea de libertate \u00een mod ilegal
(1)Lipsirea de libertate a unei persoane \u00een mod ilegal se pedepse\u0219te cu \u00eenchisoarea de la unu la 7 ani.
(2)Se consider\u0103 lipsire de libertate \u0219i r\u0103pirea unei persoane aflate \u00een imposibilitatea de a-\u0219i exprima voin\u021ba ori de a se ap\u0103ra.
(3)Dac\u0103 fapta este s\u0103v\u00e2r\u0219it\u0103:
a)de c\u0103tre o persoan\u0103 \u00eenarmat\u0103;
b)asupra unui minor;
c)pun\u00e2nd \u00een pericol s\u0103n\u0103tatea sau via\u021ba victimei, pedeapsa este \u00eenchisoarea cuprins\u0103 \u00eentre 3 \u0219i 10 ani.
(4)Dac\u0103 fapta a avut ca urmare moartea victimei, pedeapsa este \u00eenchisoarea de la 7 la 15 ani \u0219i interzicerea exercit\u0103rii unor drepturi.
(5)Tentativa la infrac\u021biunile prevazute \u00een alin. (1)-(3) se pedepse\u0219te.

== \u03a0\u03b1\u03c1\u03b1\u03c0\u03bf\u03bc\u03c0\u03ad\u03c2 ==

== \u0395\u03be\u03c9\u03c4\u03b5\u03c1\u03b9\u03ba\u03bf\u03af \u03c3\u03cd\u03bd\u03b4\u03b5\u03c3\u03bc\u03bf\u03b9 ==

\u0395\u03c0\u03af\u03c3\u03b7\u03bc\u03b7 \u03b9\u03c3\u03c4\u03bf\u03c3\u03b5\u03bb\u03af\u03b4\u03b1
Monique Philippart n\u00e9e Schmitt (born 1955) is a Luxembourgish children's writer who writes in German. In 2010 she won the L\u00ebtzebuerger Buchpr\u00e4is (Luxembourg Book Prize) for children and youth literature for her novel Gartenzwerge k\u00fcsst man nicht (You Don't Kiss Garden Gnomes).

== Biography ==
Born in Esch-sur-Alzette on 15 June 1955, Monique Schmitt matriculated from the Lyc\u00e9e des Jeunes Filles in 1973. For the next three years she looked after children who had hearing impairments before travelling to Brazil where she worked in an SOS children's village in S\u00e3o Paulo (1977\u201380). After returning to Luxembourg, she took a correspondence course in theology from the University of W\u00fcrzburg (1984\u201386). She then taught religion and German in various local primary schools until 2000.
Monique Philippart's literary career is devoted to works for children, often addressing depressions, family conflicts, sickness and drug problems. She received her first award in 1977 for the theatrical sketches she had written for a children's contest organized by Luxembourg's Sparkasse savings bank. In 2001, the jury of the Prix Servais awarded her a mention sp\u00e9eciale for her novel Laura. In 2010, she won the L\u00ebtzebuerger Buchpr\u00e4is for children's works.

== Personal life ==
Together with her husband Yves Philippart, she has brought up 11 children, some her own, the others adopted.

Neuenbaum ist eine Ortslage im Norden der bergischen Gro\u00dfstadt Wuppertal.

== Lage und Beschreibung ==
Die Ortslage liegt im Norden des Wohnquartiers Uellendahl-Ost im Stadtbezirk Uellendahl-Katernberg auf einer H\u00f6he von 278 m \u00fc. NHN an der Stra\u00dfe Neuenbaumer Weg. 
Benachbarte Orte sind neben D\u00f6nberg die H\u00f6fe und Ortslagen Am Neuen S\u00fcltekop, Am Hartkopfsh\u00e4uschen, Woltersberg, Adamsh\u00e4uschen, Langenbruch, Goldene Kothen, Im Siepen, Am Hasenkamp, In der Sonne und das unmittelbar danebenliegende Katzenbruch. Bei Neuenbaum entspringt der Heidacker Bach.

== Etymologie und Geschichte ==
In der lokalen Mundart wurde der Ort auch als Neuenboom oder auch Em Schoalb\u00fcschgen bezeichnet. Letzteres geht auf eine Schule im Ort zur\u00fcck.
Im 19. Jahrhundert geh\u00f6rte Neuenbaum zu den Au\u00dfenortschaften der Bauerschaft und der Kirchengemeinde D\u00f6nberg in der B\u00fcrgermeisterei Hardenberg, die 1935 in Neviges umbenannt wurde. Damit geh\u00f6rte es von 1816 bis 1861 zum Kreis Elberfeld und ab 1861 zum alten Kreis Mettmann. 
Der Ort ist auf der Topographischen Aufnahme der Rheinlande von 1824 als Schule beschriftet. Auf der Preu\u00dfischen Uraufnahme von 1843 ist der Ort als Schulb\u00fcschgen eingezeichnet, auf dem Wuppertaler Stadtplan von 1930 ist er mit Neuenbaum beschriftet.
Im Gemeindelexikon f\u00fcr die Provinz Rheinland von 1888 werden f\u00fcr Neuenbaum ein Wohnhaus mit 10 Einwohnern angegeben.
S\u00fcdlich von Neuenbaum verlief ein Kohlenweg von Sprockh\u00f6vel nach Elberfeld, auf dem im ausgehenden 18. Jahrhundert und in der ersten H\u00e4lfte des 19. Jahrhunderts Steinkohle von den Zechen im s\u00fcdlichen Ruhrgebiet zu den Fabriken im Wuppertal transportiert wurde, das in dieser Zeit das industrielle Herz der Region war. Ein Abzweig nach D\u00f6nberg, der heutige Neuenbaumer Weg ist bereits auf der Topographischen Aufnahme der Rheinlande von 1824 eingezeichnet.
Mit der Kommunalreform von 1929 wurde der s\u00fcdliche Teil D\u00f6nbergs von Neviges abgespalten und mit weiteren, au\u00dferhalb von D\u00f6nberg liegenden Nevigeser Ortschaften in die neu gegr\u00fcndete Stadt Wuppertal eingemeindet, so auch Neuenbaum. N\u00f6rdlich von Neuenbaum verlief bis 1975 die Stadtgrenze zwischen Wuppertal und Neviges, s\u00fcdlich davon bis 1929 die von Neviges zu Elberfeld. Durch die nordrhein-westf\u00e4lische Gebietsreform kam Neviges mit Beginn des Jahres 1975 zur Stadt Velbert und das restliche D\u00f6nberg wurde ebenfalls in Wuppertal eingemeindet. Dadurch verlor Neuenbaum seine Grenzlage.

== Literatur ==
Rolf M\u00fcller: D\u00f6nberg, eine Kirchengemeinde am Rande, Aussaat Verlag, Wuppertal, 1976

== Einzelnachweise ==
The Devil Inside \u00e9 um jogo de terror e tiro em terceira pessoa desenvolvido pela Gamesquad e publicado pela Cryo Interactive e TalonSoft para Microsoft Windows em 2000.

== Gameplay ==
The Devil Inside \u00e9 apresentado como um reality show que documenta as fa\u00e7anhas sobrenaturais do protagonista Dave e seu alter ego, uma s\u00facubo chamada Deva. O jogador pode se transformar entre Dave e Deva ativando pentagramas localizados em certos lugares ao longo dos n\u00edveis do jogo. Durante o jogo, Dave/Deva \u00e9 seguido por uma pequena c\u00e2mera voadora e tamb\u00e9m por um cinegrafista, e o jogador pode alternar entre as duas vis\u00f5es de c\u00e2mera conforme desejado. Ocasionalmente, um helic\u00f3ptero de not\u00edcias tamb\u00e9m estar\u00e1 presente e cenas roteirizadas ser\u00e3o vistas de uma perspectiva a\u00e9rea.
O ritmo, a explora\u00e7\u00e3o e o fator quebra-cabe\u00e7a do jogo s\u00e3o semelhantes aos de outros t\u00edtulos de survival horror. Como Dave, o jogador tem acesso a uma variedade de armas, que s\u00e3o equipadas com miras laser para ajudar o jogador a mirar. Como Deva, o jogador usa magias para atacar inimigos. Os feiti\u00e7os n\u00e3o requerem muni\u00e7\u00e3o, mas esgotam o mana, que se regenera lentamente. Alguns inimigos geram almas quando mortos, e Deva pode absorver almas para repor seu mana. Deva tamb\u00e9m tem a habilidade de voar e regenerar sa\u00fade quando est\u00e1 no fogo. O jogo usa um sistema de salvamento em "checkpoints" representados por aparelhos de televis\u00e3o encontrados no jogo.

== Desenvolvimento ==
O roteiro do jogo foi escrito por Hubert Chardot, mais conhecido por seu trabalho na s\u00e9rie de jogos Alone in the Dark. Seu tema \u00e9 semelhante ao de The Running Man, escrito por Stephen King, cujo nome \u00e9 mencionado no in\u00edcio do jogo.

== Recep\u00e7\u00e3o ==

O jogo recebeu "an\u00e1lises favor\u00e1veis" de acordo com o site Metacritic.
Greg Kasavin, do GameSpot, citou dificuldades na jogabilidade, por conta das configura\u00e7\u00f5es padr\u00e3o de controle. Em rela\u00e7\u00e3o \u00e0s cenas de a\u00e7\u00e3o do jogo, Kasavin opinou que: "Algumas das batalhas s\u00e3o muito bem roteirizadas. [...] Mas outras vezes, o combate \u00e9 ruim." Os ambientes do jogo foram elogiados por seu realismo e atmosfera sombria e imersiva, enquanto os modelos de personagens e efeitos sonoros foram classificados como simples. No geral, o jogo foi descrito como competente, mas sem polimento. A PC Gamer US elogiou as anima\u00e7\u00f5es, os \u00e2ngulos de c\u00e2mera, o uso de dois personagens e a baixa curva de aprendizado que o jogo possui. No entanto, o revisor citou: "figuras poligonais e texturiza\u00e7\u00e3o mal feitas" e alguns bugs de ambiente como os pontos baixos do jogo..Eric Bratcher da NextGen chamou-o de "Uma divers\u00e3o envolvente onde ' Illbleed encontra Space Channel 5 ', mas a apresenta\u00e7\u00e3o \u00fanica n\u00e3o consegue ofuscar as fraquezas da IA e do design dos quebra-cabe\u00e7as."
Na Pol\u00f4nia, foi um dos primeiros lan\u00e7amentos de uma s\u00e9rie de estreias de jogos baratos na revista ExtraGra. Pouco depois do lan\u00e7amento do jogo, uma das esta\u00e7\u00f5es de TV mais populares da Pol\u00f4nia, a TVN, transmitiu uma reportagem sobre o jogo, acusando o distribuidor, CD Projekt, de vender jogos sat\u00e2nicos em lojas e com f\u00e1cil acesso. O aviso de epilepsia, que na altura j\u00e1 era comum entre os jogos lan\u00e7ados na Pol\u00f3nia e quase onipresente na Europa, foi usado como exemplo do impacto excepcionalmente negativo do jogo aos jovens.
De acordo com Der Spiegel, The Devil Inside n\u00e3o obteve sucesso comercial.

Etran Finatawa ("le stelle della tradizione") \u00e8 un gruppo musicale del Niger. I musicisti provengono da due etnie nigerine diverse: i Tuareg e i Wodaabe.

== Storia ==
La band \u00e8 stata formata nel 2004 durante il Festival au d\u00e9sert vicino a Timbuct\u00f9. Essi sono il primo gruppo ad utilizzare le canzoni e la musica del popolo Wodaabe in un contesto moderno. Hanno iniziato come un gruppo di dieci musicisti che hanno voluto unire le due culture nomadi, come simbolo di pace. La band \u00e8 composta da due musicisti tuareg e tre Wodaabe. La musica delle due trib\u00f9 \u00e8 molto diversa, ma il modo in cui \u00e8 stata abbinata ha prodotto un suono potente e ipnotico e un nuovo stile musicale del Desert blues.
Le loro canzoni raccontano storie di vita nomade, di isolamento e di libert\u00e0, di disagio e povert\u00e0 estrema, di un clima rigido, di belle donne e dei giorni felici, di feste e delle famiglie, delle stelle e le tempeste del deserto.

Intervista a Etran Finatawa, su ard.de. URL consultato il 14 agosto 2010 (archiviato dall'url originale il 27 novembre 2024).
Niszczyciele typu Almirante Lynch \u2013 typ chilijskich du\u017cych niszczycieli (lider\u00f3w) z pocz\u0105tku XX wieku, s\u0142u\u017c\u0105cych r\u00f3wnie\u017c w marynarce brytyjskiej. W latach 1912\u20131915 w stoczni J. Samuel White w Cowes zbudowano sze\u015b\u0107 okr\u0119t\u00f3w tego typu, jednak tylko dwie jednostki wesz\u0142y w sk\u0142ad Armada de Chile przed wybuchem I wojny \u015bwiatowej. Pozosta\u0142e cztery niszczyciele zosta\u0142y zarekwirowane przez rz\u0105d brytyjski i wcielone do Royal Navy, a trzy z nich po zako\u0144czeniu dzia\u0142a\u0144 wojennych (bez utraconego w bitwa jutlandzkiej HMS \u201eTipperary\u201d) trafi\u0142y do pierwotnego zamawiaj\u0105cego. Okr\u0119ty te skre\u015blono z listy floty w 1933 roku, a dwa pierwsze s\u0142u\u017cy\u0142y do po\u0142owy lat 40. XX wieku.

== Projekt i budowa ==
Niszczyciele typu Almirante Lynch zosta\u0142y zam\u00f3wione przez rz\u0105d Chile w ramach programu rozbudowy floty z 1910 roku, jako odpowied\u017a na zam\u00f3wienie przez Argentyn\u0119 12 nowoczesnych niszczycieli, kt\u00f3re z kolei by\u0142y odpowiedzi\u0105 na zbrojenia Brazylii. Poniewa\u017c okr\u0119ty chilijskie mia\u0142y by\u0107 mniej liczne, zdecydowano zbudowa\u0107 jednostki silniejsze od argenty\u0144skich. Marynarka Chile mia\u0142a tradycyjne zwi\u0105zki z marynark\u0105 brytyjsk\u0105 i w Wielkiej Brytanii te\u017c zdecydowano ulokowa\u0107 zam\u00f3wienie. W 1911 roku parlament Chile wyasygnowa\u0142 \u015brodki na dwie pierwsze jednostki, kt\u00f3re zam\u00f3wiono w stoczni J. Samuel White w Cowes, zakre\u015blaj\u0105c jej tylko og\u00f3lne wymagania, w tym g\u00f3rn\u0105 wyporno\u015b\u0107 i rozmieszczenie uzbrojenia umo\u017cliwiaj\u0105ce prowadzenie walki z obu burt r\u00f3wnocze\u015bnie. W momencie budowy okr\u0119ty te nale\u017ca\u0142y do najwi\u0119kszych i najsilniej uzbrojonych jednostek tej klasy na \u015bwiecie\u2009. Projekt uko\u0144czono przed po\u0142o\u017ceniem st\u0119pki pierwszego okr\u0119tu 9 listopada 1911 roku. Z zam\u00f3wionych sze\u015bciu niszczycieli tylko dwa zosta\u0142y uko\u0144czone do wybuchu I wojny \u015bwiatowej i odebrane przez Armada de Chile (\u201eAlmirante Lynch\u201d i \u201eAlmirante Condell\u201d); pozosta\u0142e cztery zosta\u0142y zarekwirowane przez rz\u0105d brytyjski i wcielone do Royal Navy jako HMS \u201eFaulknor\u201d, HMS \u201eBroke\u201d, HMS \u201eBotha\u201d i HMS \u201eTipperary\u201d\u2009.
Przej\u0119te przez Brytyjczyk\u00f3w niszczyciele (nazwane przewodnikami flotylli typu Faulknor) zosta\u0142y lekko zmodyfikowane w stosunku do pierwowzoru: zamontowano na nich wyrzutnie torpedowe o kalibrze 533 mm i pojedyncze dzia\u0142ko przeciwlotnicze kal. 40 mm (zamiast dw\u00f3ch karabin\u00f3w maszynowych kal. 7,7 mm), a wi\u0119ksza masa zainstalowanego uzbrojenia spowodowa\u0142a wzrost wyporno\u015bci okr\u0119t\u00f3w\u2009.
Wszystkie jednostki typu Almirante Lynch zosta\u0142y zbudowane w brytyjskiej stoczni J. Samuel White w Cowes\u2009\u2009. St\u0119pki okr\u0119t\u00f3w po\u0142o\u017cono w latach 1911\u20131912, a zwodowane zosta\u0142y w latach 1912\u20131915\u2009\u2009.

== Dane taktyczno-techniczne ==

Okr\u0119ty mia\u0142y kad\u0142ub z podwy\u017cszonym pok\u0142adem dziobowym na d\u0142ugo\u015bci ok. 28 m, lekko wznosz\u0105cym si\u0119 w kierunku dziobu. Mia\u0142y jeden ci\u0105g\u0142y pok\u0142ad g\u00f3rny, a ponadto pok\u0142ad dolny (platform\u0119) w cz\u0119\u015bci dziobowej i rufowej. Skonstruowane by\u0142y w klasycznym poprzecznym uk\u0142adzie wi\u0105za\u0144, z rozstawem wr\u0119g o 53 cm. Kad\u0142ub dzieli\u0142 si\u0119 grodziami na 21 poprzecznych przedzia\u0142\u00f3w wodoszczelnych (cz\u0119\u015b\u0107 z nich tylko do dolnego pok\u0142adu). Centraln\u0105 cz\u0119\u015b\u0107 kad\u0142uba zajmowa\u0142y trzy przedzia\u0142y kot\u0142owni (o d\u0142ugo\u015bci 12,3 m ka\u017cdy) i jeden maszynowni (13,9 m). W\u0105skie dno podw\u00f3jne by\u0142o tylko pod kot\u0142owniami i maszynowniami.
Okr\u0119ty by\u0142y du\u017cymi niszczycielami o d\u0142ugo\u015bci ca\u0142kowitej 100,8 metra (97,5 metra mi\u0119dzy pionami), szeroko\u015bci 9,9 metra i zanurzeniu 3,35\u20133,53 metra\u2009\u2009. Wyporno\u015b\u0107 normalna wynosi\u0142a 1430\u20131610 ton, a pe\u0142na 1850\u20132000 ton\u2009\u2009. 
=== Nap\u0119d ===
Si\u0142owni\u0119 okr\u0119t\u00f3w stanowi\u0142y trzy turbiny parowe systemu Parsonsa o \u0142\u0105cznej mocy 30 000 KM, nap\u0119dzaj\u0105ce trzy \u015bruby. Na \u015brodkowy wa\u0142 pracowa\u0142a turbina wysokiego ci\u015bnienia ze stopniem pr\u0119dko\u015bci kr\u0105\u017cowniczej, a na zewn\u0119trzne wa\u0142y turbiny niskiego ci\u015bnienia, ze stopniami biegu wstecznego. Maksymalna pr\u0119dko\u015b\u0107 obrotowa \u015brub wynosi\u0142a 600 obr./min. Par\u0119 dostarcza\u0142o sze\u015b\u0107 kot\u0142\u00f3w wodnorurkowych White-Forster o ci\u015bnieniu roboczym 15,4 at. Kot\u0142y by\u0142y zgrupowane po dwa w ka\u017cdej kot\u0142owni, a spaliny odprowadza\u0142y z nich cztery kominy (drugi i trzeci \u2013 z dw\u00f3ch kot\u0142\u00f3w). Kot\u0142y mia\u0142y opalanie mieszane, a od burt oddziela\u0142y je zasobnie w\u0119glowe, kt\u00f3re przy wysokim zapasie w\u0119gla dawa\u0142y pewn\u0105 os\u0142on\u0119 od od\u0142amk\u00f3w i pocisk\u00f3w ma\u0142ego kalibru.
Projektowa pr\u0119dko\u015b\u0107 maksymalna okr\u0119t\u00f3w wynosi\u0142a 31 w\u0119z\u0142\u00f3w\u2009\u2009. Pr\u0119dko\u015b\u0107 tak\u0105 osi\u0105ga\u0142y jednak w stanie lekkim (na pr\u00f3bach \u201eAlmirante Lynch\u201d, przy wyporno\u015bci nieco ponad 1500 ton), natomiast na pr\u00f3bach 6-godzinnych \u201eBroke\u201d osi\u0105ga\u0142 pr\u0119dko\u015b\u0107 \u015bredni\u0105 29,9 w przy wyporno\u015bci 1700 ton i 28,3 w przy wyporno\u015bci pe\u0142nej 1900 ton.
Okr\u0119ty zabiera\u0142y zapas 427\u2013433 tony w\u0119gla i 80\u201383 tony paliwa p\u0142ynnego, co zapewnia\u0142o zasi\u0119g wynosz\u0105cy 2750 Mm przy pr\u0119dko\u015bci 15 w\u0119z\u0142\u00f3w\u2009\u2009. 
=== Uzbrojenie ===

Uzbrojenie artyleryjskie wed\u0142ug oryginalnego projektu, jakie przenosi\u0142y pierwsze dwa okr\u0119ty, sk\u0142ada\u0142o si\u0119 z sze\u015bciu pojedynczych dzia\u0142 kalibru 102 mm (4 cale) o d\u0142ugo\u015bci lufy 40 kalibr\u00f3w (L/40)\u2009. By\u0142y to dzia\u0142a firmy Armstrong eksportowego wzoru S\u2009, przyj\u0119tego przez marynark\u0119 brytyjsk\u0105 jako QF Mk VI, instalowane na podstawach P XI o k\u0105cie podniesienia do 25\u00b0. Rozmieszczone by\u0142y po trzy na ka\u017cdej z burt: pierwsza para na pok\u0142adzie dziobowym, druga na pok\u0142adzie g\u00f3rnym po bokach pierwszego komina i ostatnia para na rufie. Od trzeciego okr\u0119tu druga para dzia\u0142 zosta\u0142a przeniesiona nieco do przodu i wy\u017cej na koniec pok\u0142adu dziobowego, co polepszy\u0142o warunki prowadzenia ognia. Strzela\u0142y one pociskami o masie 31 funt\u00f3w (14 kg). Amunicj\u0119 dostarcza\u0142y windy elektryczne z dziobowej i rufowej komory amunicyjnej. Uzbrojenie uzupe\u0142nia\u0142y cztery pojedyncze karabiny maszynowe Maxim kal. 7,7 mm ustawione na pok\u0142adzie. Podczas modernizacji w 1930 roku otrzyma\u0142y dwa podw\u00f3jnie sprz\u0119\u017cone karabiny maszynowe kalibru 12,7 mm na nadbud\u00f3wce rufowej.
Uzbrojenie torpedowe wed\u0142ug projektu stanowi\u0142o sze\u015b\u0107 wyrzutni torpedowych kalibru 450 mm (18 cali) w trzech podw\u00f3jnych obrotowych aparatach, lecz poniewa\u017c podw\u00f3jne wyrzutnie nie by\u0142y jeszcze gotowe w chwili wej\u015bcia do s\u0142u\u017cby, zamontowano na dw\u00f3ch pierwszych okr\u0119tach trzy pojedyncze wyrzutnie tego kalibru. Umieszczone by\u0142y na pok\u0142adzie w osi pod\u0142u\u017cnej kad\u0142uba mi\u0119dzy drugim i trzecim oraz mi\u0119dzy trzecim i czwartym kominem oraz za nadbud\u00f3wk\u0105 rufow\u0105. W 1930 roku na dw\u00f3ch pierwszych okr\u0119tach zamieniono je na dwie podw\u00f3jne wyrzutnie torped kalibru 533 mm w tych samych miejscach mi\u0119dzy kominami.
Okr\u0119ty przej\u0119te przez Brytyjczyk\u00f3w pocz\u0105tkowo mia\u0142y takie samo uzbrojenie artyleryjskie, z sze\u015bciu pojedynczych dzia\u0142 Armstrong kalibru 102 mm L/40. Dwa pierwsze \u201eFaulknor\u201d i \u201eBroke\u201d zachowa\u0142y zgodne z ulepszonym projektem rozmieszczenie dzia\u0142 parami, z drug\u0105 par\u0105 dzia\u0142 ustawion\u0105 na ko\u0144cu pok\u0142adu dziobowego. Na dw\u00f3ch ostatnich \u201eBotha\u201d i \u201eTipperary\u201d jednak zmieniono rozmieszczenie dzia\u0142 i zainstalowano na dziobie i rufie pojedyncze dzia\u0142a centralnie, a par\u0119 zwolnionych w ten spos\u00f3b dzia\u0142 ustawiono na burtach za nadbud\u00f3wk\u0105 rufow\u0105, dzi\u0119ki czemu liczba dzia\u0142 w salwie burtowej wzros\u0142a do czterech. Brytyjskie okr\u0119ty otrzyma\u0142y dodatkowo pojedyncze automatyczne dzia\u0142ko przeciwlotnicze kalibru 37 mm (1\u00bd-funtowe) Vickers na nadbud\u00f3wce mi\u0119dzy drugim a trzecim kominem, a \u201eBotha\u201d i \u201eTipperary\u201d tak\u017ce mi\u0119dzy trzecim a czwartym kominem, po czym w toku s\u0142u\u017cby zamieniono je na wszystkich okr\u0119tach na dwa automatyczne dzia\u0142ka kalibru 40 mm (2-funtowe) Vickers Mk II L/39. Uzbrojenie dope\u0142nia\u0142y dwa pojedyncze karabiny maszynowe kal. 7,7 mm\u2009. W wi\u0119kszym stopniu zmieniono bro\u0144 torpedow\u0105, na cztery wyrzutnie skuteczniejszych torped kalibru 533 mm (21 cali). Dwa pierwsze przej\u0119te okr\u0119ty otrzyma\u0142y cztery obrotowe pojedyncze wyrzutnie, umieszczone po dwie na burt\u0119, po bokach pok\u0142adu g\u00f3rnego, mi\u0119dzy trzecim a czwartym kominem i za nadbud\u00f3wk\u0105 rufow\u0105. Dwa ostatnie natomiast uko\u0144czono z dwoma podw\u00f3jnymi aparatami torpedowymi: na lewej burcie przed czwartym kominem i na prawej burcie za czwartym kominem.
W marcu 1918 rok na \u201eBroke\u201d po dwa dzia\u0142a kalibru 102 mm z dziobu i rufy zamieniono na pojedyncze centralnie umieszczone dzia\u0142a kalibru 120 mm na podstawach CP.VI, pozostawiaj\u0105c dwa dzia\u0142a 102 mm na ko\u0144cach pok\u0142adu dziobowego. W 1919 roku analogicznie przezbrojono \u201eFaulknor\u201d i \u201eBotha\u201d.

=== Wyposa\u017cenie, za\u0142oga ===
Niszczyciele mia\u0142y pocz\u0105tkowo dwa reflektory bojowe i dwa dalmierze o bazie 7 st\u00f3p (2,1 m), na mostku i nadbud\u00f3wce rufowej.
Okr\u0119ty mia\u0142y ster zbalansowany o powierzchni 6,5 m\u00b2, z nap\u0119dem elektrycznym i awaryjnym r\u0119cznym maszyny sterowej. Manewrowo\u015b\u0107 okr\u0119t\u00f3w by\u0142a jednak ma\u0142o zadowalaj\u0105ca i s\u0142absza od wi\u0119kszego lidera \u201eSwift\u201d, zw\u0142aszcza przy cyrkulacji w lewo (na skutek niesymetrycznego trzy\u015brubowego uk\u0142adu).
Za\u0142oga wed\u0142ug pocz\u0105tkowego projektu dla okr\u0119t\u00f3w w s\u0142u\u017cbie chilijskiej liczy\u0142a 160 oficer\u00f3w, podoficer\u00f3w i marynarzy. W s\u0142u\u017cbie brytyjskiej wynosi\u0142a etatowo 197 os\u00f3b dla pierwszej dw\u00f3jki i 205 os\u00f3b dla drugiej.
Okr\u0119ty wed\u0142ug projektu przenosi\u0142y sze\u015b\u0107 \u0142odzi: kuter motorowy d\u0142ugo\u015bci 24 st\u00f3p (7,3 m), dwa welboty d\u0142ugo\u015bci 25 st\u00f3p (7,6 m), dwa gigi d\u0142ugo\u015bci 24 st\u00f3p (7,3 m) i b\u0105czek 16-stopowy (4,9 m). Na okr\u0119tach brytyjskich modyfikowano i zmniejszano zestaw \u0142odzi.

== S\u0142u\u017cba ==
\u201eAlmirante Lynch\u201d i \u201eAlmirante Condell\u201d zosta\u0142y przyj\u0119te w sk\u0142ad Armada de Chile w latach 1913\u20131914\u2009. 7 lutego 1914 roku oba niszczyciele wyp\u0142yn\u0119\u0142y w rejs do Chile, docieraj\u0105c na miejsce 22 kwietnia 1914 roku\u2009. W 1930 roku okr\u0119ty poddano modernizacji: przystosowano kot\u0142y do opalania wy\u0142\u0105cznie paliwem p\u0142ynnym (co powi\u0119kszy\u0142o zasi\u0119g do 4200 Mm przy pr\u0119dko\u015bci 15 w\u0119z\u0142\u00f3w), a tak\u017ce zdemontowano pojedyncze wyrzutnie torpedowe kal. 450 mm, instaluj\u0105c w zamian dwa podw\u00f3jne aparaty kal. 533 mm\u2009. Jednostki wycofano ze s\u0142u\u017cby w latach 1944-1945\u2009.

Pozosta\u0142e cztery jednostki w trakcie prac wyposa\u017ceniowych zosta\u0142y na pocz\u0105tku wojny zakupione przez rz\u0105d brytyjski i wesz\u0142y do s\u0142u\u017cby w Royal Navy w latach 1914-1915, jako \u201eFaulknor\u201d (ex-\u201eAlmirante Simpson\u201d), \u201eBroke\u201d (ex-\u201eAlmirante Go\u00f1i\u201d), \u201eBotha\u201d (ex-\u201eAlmirante Williams Rebolledo\u201d) i \u201eTipperary\u201d (ex-\u201eAlmirante Riveros\u201d)\u2009. \u201eFaulknor\u201d, \u201eBroke\u201d i \u201eTipperary\u201d wzi\u0119\u0142y udzia\u0142 w bitwie jutlandzkiej, podczas kt\u00f3rej \u201eBroke\u201d dozna\u0142 ci\u0119\u017ckich uszkodze\u0144, a \u201eTipperary\u201d zosta\u0142 zatopiony. W latach 1918\u20131919 okr\u0119ty poddano modernizacji: zdemontowano cztery pojedyncze dzia\u0142a kal. 102 mm, instaluj\u0105c w zamian dwie armaty kal. 120 mm BL Mk I L/45\u2009.
W 1920 roku trzy ocala\u0142e niszczyciele zosta\u0142y odsprzedane Chile i w maju tego roku wesz\u0142y do s\u0142u\u017cby w marynarce tego kraju pod nazwami \u201eAlmirante Riveros\u201d (ex-\u201eFaulknor\u201d), \u201eAlmirante Uribe\u201d (ex-\u201eBroke\u201d) i \u201eAlmirante Williams\u201d (ex-\u201eBotha\u201d), okre\u015blane od tego momentu typem Almirante Williams\u2009. Wed\u0142ug A. Daszjana jednak, powszechnie przyj\u0119ta identyfikacja okr\u0119t\u00f3w jest mylna i analiza fotografii wskazuje na to, \u017ce \u201eBotha\u201d otrzyma\u0142 nazw\u0119 \u201eAlmirante Riveros\u201d, a \u201eFaulknor\u201d \u2013 \u201eAlmirante Williams\u201d. Jednostki zosta\u0142y skre\u015blone z listy floty z powodu znacznego zu\u017cycia w 1933 roku\u2009.

== Tham kh\u1ea3o ==
Clare Hall, Cambridge \u00dcniversitesi'nin kolejlerinden biridir. 1966 y\u0131l\u0131nda Clare Koleji taraf\u0131ndan kurulmu\u015f olup daha \u00e7ok lisans\u00fcst\u00fc \u00f6\u011frencilerinin yan\u0131 s\u0131ra doktora sonras\u0131 ara\u015ft\u0131rmac\u0131 ve ara\u015ft\u0131rma g\u00f6revlilerini de kabul eden ileri d\u00fczeyde e\u011fitim veren bir kolej olarak hizmet vermektedir.

== Kaynak\u00e7a ==

== D\u0131\u015f ba\u011flant\u0131lar ==

Resm\u00ee site (\u0130ngilizce)
Aeroportul George M. Bryan (IATA: nicio valoare, ICAO: KSTF, FAA LID: STF) este un aeroport din Mississippi, Statele Unite ale Americii ce deserve\u0219te zona Starkville\u2060(d)[[Starkville (city in Mississippi, United States)|\u200b]]. Aeroportul a fost tranzitat \u00een 2019 de 20 de pasageri.
Situat la o altitudine de 101 m, aeroportul dispune de 1 pist\u0103.

== Infrastructur\u0103 ==

=== Piste ===
Aeroportul dispune de o singur\u0103 pist\u0103. Pista 18/36 are dimensiunile 5.550 picioare \u00d7 150 picioare.
